я не разобралась, как зачекиниться - мне пришло 4 письма, но ни в одном из них не было нужной информации. пин код в письме не подходил к двери

Upside_Review: Понравился уютный лаундж на первом этаже
Downside_Review: Душевые в нижнем этаже, немного удаленно от комнаты

Upside_Review: Отличное расположение, и до главных достопримечательностей, и до вокзала можно добраться пешком (рядом, кстати, заведение Ben's Chili Bowl, которое, как я поняла, само по себе считается достопримечательностью). Адекватное соотношение цены и качества. Чистота! И капсулы, и общественные пространства чистые, аккуратные. Конечно, душ как в общественной бане (кстати, не забудьте сланцы, если что), но все очень чистое, есть всякие средства гигиены, фен и т.д. Чистое постельное белье и полотенца. Капсулы достаточно просторные. За счет того, что это не просто койки, а капсулы, которые закрываются жалюзи, есть ощущение уединения. Кто-то писал в отзывах, что нельзя внутри капсулы телефон на зарядку поставить, у меня такой проблемы не было - внутри капсулы был USB-порт, все нормально заряжалось. В целом я довольна
Downside_Review: Приложение для self-check-in и общения с персоналом - это просто катастрофа! Я честно пыталась его установить, но не получилось (возможно, телефон слишком старый, тогда, извините, это дискриминация людей со старыми телефонами!). Причем для регистрации, хотя деньги списываются через Booking, надо ввести данные банковской карты с CVC. Официально заезд c 15:00, но, предупреждает хостел в письме, с 13:00 до 18:00 за стойкой никого нет, регистрация только самостоятельная. Я написала администрации несколько сообщений через Booking и письмо на почту, предупредила, что у меня проблемы с установкой приложения, мол, будет ли кто-то в 18:00, чтобы меня запустить, никто мне так и не ответил. Пришла после 18:00, поломилась в дверь, подождала. Ну, через какое-то время, к счастью, пришел администратор, зарегистрировал меня. Коды на вход в здание и в комнату пришли на почту. Кстати, общий код на вход 4-значный, а в комнату - 7-значный: если у вас плохая память, в туалет без телефона лучше не ходить)))

Upside_Review: Удобное расположение, практически за углом станция метро. В самом хостеле довольно чисто, но в туалете был грязный унитаз. Душевые расположены в подвале, не на этаже. Рядом много разных баров, кафе, через дорогу Wallgreens. В самой капсуле есть полочки, крючки, розетки - стандартный набор. Спать было удобно, главное не забыть беруши.
Downside_Review: Сложно было понять, как заселиться самостоятельно, нужна более подробная инструкция, либо предупреждать об этом заранее, до бронирования. Хорошо, что я прочитала сообщение от хостела до приезда, и у меня было время скачать приложение, зарегистрироваться, и т.д. Стафф не работает с 13-00 до 18-00, это непривычно. Район не очень безопасный, гулять там девушке одной вечером было страшновато.

Upside_Review: Наличие отдельного номера на двоих с собственным душем и туалетом. Удобное расположение, рядом со станцией метро и автобусными остановка на соседней улице (14).
Downside_Review: Не могли зайти в Хостел, так как нам поздно сообщили о необходимости самостоятельной регистрации и получения кода доступа в хостел. Пришлось искать доступ к Интернету, чтобы зарегистрироваться. Недостаточная звукоизоляция. Район, в котором расположен хостел очень активный и шумный, особенно в выходные дни, окно номера выходило на проезжую часть, поэтому было слышно и музыку, и крики и частые сигналы полицейских машин.

Upside_Review:
Рядом есть пару супермаркетов, где можно купить все необходимое. Удобный матрас и подушка. В коридоре есть миникухня с мойкой, холодильником, микроволновкой и набором посуды.
Прикольный доступ в комнату и в сам хостел через приложение в телефоне
Downside_Review: Капсулы без какой либо шумоизоляции, нет ящиков куда можно было убрать вещи или документы на ключ, в душе горячая вода появляется через 2-3 минуты

Upside_Review:
Очень грязно и простыни не стирают
Отель не самый лучший
Шикарный номер, ремонт свежий, сантехника в ванной новая и в рабочем состоянии. Вкусный завтрак) можно было выпекать вафельки)

Были в Вашингтоне 3 дня/2 ночи, отель нам очень понравился. Чистота, аккуратность, в номерах есть все самое необходимое и очень тихий, зелёный район. Завтраеи отменные, вкусно и на любой вкус. Рядом с отелем есть ресторан итальянской кухни, там очень вкусная еда, и к сожалению в пешей доступности больше ничего нет. Ехать в центр города смотреть достопремечательности примерно 30 минут. Спасибо отелю!
Downside_Review: Персонал немного не дружелюбный, мы много путешествуем и чаще встречали приветливый персонал, а здесь немного хмурые, неприветливые ребята.

Upside_Review: Прекрасный персонал во всем помогали

Downside_Review: изношенный, есть неприятный запах.

Upside_Review: В комнате было достаточно чисто
Downside_Review: В комнате было очень влажно. Отель напоминает общежитие. В помещении для завтрака был дым из кухни. Шумоизоляция в комнате очень низкая.

Upside_Review: Ничего выдающегося.
Downside_Review: Бассейн не работает, принадлежностей для барбекью нет. Хотя в описании написано, что есть. Никаких предупреждений о недоступности при бронировании не было.

Upside_Review: Две двуспальные кровати в номере, парковка
Downside_Review:
Ехали с семьей мимо Вашингтона, надо было просто переночевать, случайно выбрали этот отель. Отель старый, в номере шумно, сначала я даже подумал что окно открыто и так шумно, но окна были закрыты, а постоянный шум был. 
Рано утром нам надо было ехать дальше, время 6:15 утра, сдаю ключи от номера, спрашиваю про кофе на завтрак (его как раз принесли к завтраку который начинался в 7 утра) но мне отказали. Я спросил бутылку воды, но и про воду сказали что она платная. Вообщем персонал совсем не Френдли, видя что мы семья с двумя детьми.

Upside_Review: Удобное месторасположение по пути в Вашингтон. Большая парковка. Легко добраться. Неплохой завтрак по американским меркам.
Downside_Review: В номере очень сильный запах сигаретного дыма. В ванной всегда горит лампа, похоже для обогрева..

Upside_Review: Очень удобное расположение отеля, а номерах есть холодильник, микроволновка и кофемашина, что очень удобно. В номерах достаточно много полотенец. В отеле есть бассейн, по глубине подойдем и детям от 3-4 лет, на улице при хорошей погоде есть зона отдыха, где можно посидеть, попить кофе. Очень понравилось разнообразие завтрака. Отель находиться на возвышенности, так что оттуда открывается хорошей вид.
Downside_Review: В нашем номере были не самые чистые полы, создалось впечатление что их давно не мыли. У нас был ползающий ребенок, так что он собой их помыл. Также в ванне плохо уходила вода, после 5 минут душа, ты стоишь по колено в воде. И подтекал кран в раковине.

Upside_Review:
Ожидала, что будет балкон с видом в номере, но по итогу занавески лучше не открывать вообще. Но в нашем случае это не столь важно было. Рядом с отелем вкусный итальянский ресторан, магазин на заправке.
Утром очень порадовал горячий завтрак, за месяц путешествий по восточному побережью, это прям открытие! Большой открытый бассейн! Дети были в восторге. Чисто в номере!
Downside_Review: Вид из окна, но это не столь важно, когда останавливаешься пару ночей.

Upside_Review: Расположение супер! Хостел находится на улице баров, вечером эта улица - веселится, но, в тоже время в самом хостеле спокойно. Рядом много кафе и ресторанов на любой вкус. Очень дружелюбный и приветливый персонал, который знает разные языки! До ближайшей станции метро не очень далеко.
Downside_Review: Хостел внутри выглядит неуютно и неопрятно. В комнатах жильцами может не поддерживаться порядок, и от этого впечатление портится. Не у всех кроватей есть удобные розетки.

Upside_Review:
Относительно хорошее расположение. Разрешили въехать раньше времени. Отвечали на письма.
У этого хостела есть будущее, только если выкинуть все барахло и провести ремонт.
Downside_Review: Очень захламлено: на кухне везде стоят какие-то пакеты, кульки, баночки. Очевидно все они принадлежат "жителям', которые здесь давно. Из-за этого тут тараканы и очень неуютно. В комнатах есть кровати "долгожителей", которые используют второй ярус кроватей для своих вещей. Первой ночью меня кто-то покусал. Потом все было нормально. На клопов укусы не похожи, возможно, двухвостки, которых я видел.

Upside_Review: Очень хорошее местоположение
Downside_Review: странная атмосфера

Upside_Review: Очень грязно и 2 раз оплатил один раз через букинг 2 раз на место
Downside_Review: Грязно

Upside_Review: вежливый персонал и хорошее расположение
Downside_Review:
1.матрас проваливается до пола
2.за окном всю ночь гудит огромный генератор. даже беруши не помогают 
3. между полом и стеной дырка с палец и воняет плесенью, так как за стеной ванная комната.

Upside_Review: Я уже не первый раз останавливаюсь в этом отеле. В этот раз меня порадовало то, что цена была ниже, а номер дали шикарный, я даже не ожидала. Удобное расположение.
Downside_Review: я не знаю почему, но учитывая то, что отель берет дополнительную стоимость за уборку номера, но в этот раз я была не много разочарована в том, что мне не поменяли полотенца и даже не помыли раковину. Хотя! Отель берет дополнительную стоимость за сервис. Я хотела пожаловаться менеджеру, но так как это было 4 июля, решила не портить праздник ни себе ни работникам. Я думаю что проблема была в леди, которой просто лень было делать ее работу. А еще печалька в том что нет завтрака и холодильника. Но в целом, отель хороший! Я всегда там останавливаюсь! И впринципе всем довольна! Не смотря на некие нюансы

Upside_Review: Просторный номер, все чисто и аккуратно. Приветливый персонал.
Downside_Review: Душ немного тёк.

Upside_Review: Большой чистый номер, кофе машина, столик с креслами для завтрака, ванна, необходмые бытовые принадлежности (фен, утюг), удобные огромные кровати, приятный вид из окна. Персонал в лице одного молодого человека, делающего все возможное скрасить неловкую ситуацию с парковкой.
Downside_Review: У отеля была заявлена парковка, но по приезду в отель в 11 вечера мест не было и на прилегающей к отелю территории машину поставить не разрешили, хотя свободные места были. И мы еще 1ч 15 мин кружили по городу в поиске парковки, ибо все публичные платные были закрыты/заполнены, вдоль дорог все заставлено.

Upside_Review: только месторасположение
Downside_Review: ужасно расположен кондиционер и дует прямо на человека на кровати, не понимаю как это можно было заранее не продумать. Очень не удобные одеала, под которыми я в итоге так и не спала нормально.. не понимаю зачем столько тонких слоев в одеале которые скатываются один за другим, если можно сделать одно нормальное толстое одеало стандартного размера на человека. В итоге мне пришлось укрываться тяжелой простынью такого огромного размера что я нормально так и не смогла поспать в этом номере. Отключила кондиционер чтобы эта подстветка в глаза не светила ночью и не будила меня, но безрезультатно, так как кондиционер и heater были полностью отключены а подстветка так и работала на всю мощь! это было ужасное пребывание в этом отеле.. это какой-то кошмар. но хуже всего то что мы отдали $740 за два дня и уехали расстроенными!

Upside_Review: Расположение отличное
Downside_Review: 4 звёздами и не пахло... отель супер старый. Снимали номер на 3х, на ресепшене было сказано, что номер на 2х, а дальше делайте что хотите. На 1 ночь подойдёт, но не более. Если на машине, то надо позаботиться о парковке. Через букинг лучше не оплачивать, а по месту.

Upside_Review: Расположение хорошее, номер не плохой, хороший вид из окна
Downside_Review: Единственное что меня реально расстроило, это то что не было холодильника в номере.

Upside_Review: Персонал хороший. В номере чистота и уют. Расположение отличное.
Downside_Review: Нет холодильника в номере. Рядом нет продуктовых магазинов

Downside_Review:

Нет завтрака, закрыт ресторан

Upside_Review: Красивый номер
Downside_Review: Очень злой и не дружелюбный персонал!!!В 7.50am зашла горничная и начала орать,что ей нужно убрать номер, то что я хочу спать и мне уборка не нужна,никого не интересовало!Через 30 минут она пришла снова и я не открыла ей дверь, она позвала охранника и администратора с ресепшена они пришли ко мне в номер и очень грубо со мной разговаривали и обьяснили,что у них уборка проходит каждый день и никого не волнует что я хочу спать!И если мне что то не нравится,то я могу покинуть отель!Такого хамства со стороны персонала я не видела ни в одном отеле!Депозит не возвращают! Очень не рекомендую

Upside_Review: Всё понравилось.Только почему мне не вернули 50$,которые с меня взяли в качестве залога.И которые должны вернуть.
Отличное расположение, внимательный персонал
Мне понравилось месторасположение отеля, сотрудники вежливые.
Downside_Review: Шумный кондиционер в комнате.

Upside_Review:
Завтрак очень простой, но сытный: всегда есть scrambled eggs, бекон или сосиски, тушёные овощи, самые простые хлопья, молоко, булочки. Кофе делаешь себе сам (есть большая кофемашина).
Большой и просторный номер, был даже диван, удобная и широкая кровать.
Жаль нет вида из окон номера, но расположение отеля этого и не предполагает, мы это знали. Зато есть бар на крыше и вид прилагается (закрыт в воскресенье и понедельник), ценник очень гуманный, есть немного пива, немного коктейлей и еда типа бургеров, картошки фри, салатов, сандвичей.
В целом все понравилось, ничего лишнего не блокировали на карте, но в стоимость, указанную на букинге не был включен налог 15%, имейте ввиду.
Downside_Review:
Одноразовая посуда на завтраке - это странно, если честно уже надоело, что все прикрываются ковидом как оправданием.
Не очень удобная система у душа, слишком короткий кран на раковине (постоянно там все заливается водой).
Нет уборки, но это сейчас везде так в США, мы были готовы.

Upside_Review: Все понравилось, завтрак отличный. Хорошее расположение ко всем музеям и достопримечаниям.
Чистый, комфортный номер.
Downside_Review: Громко работал кондиционер.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review:
Hotel muy grande. La habitación era muy amplia y estaba muy limpia. El baño también, amplio y limpio, con todo lo que puedes necesitar. Las camas y almohadas eran comodísimas. En la habitación nos dejaron todos los días 4 botellas de agua gratis y en la recepción había siempre café e infusiones gratis.
El desayuno era muy completo: mucha comida china, huevos, beicon, cereales, cafés, infusiones, zumos, tostadas, bollería, yogures... 
La mayoría de los trabajadores no habla inglés, pero tienen unos traductores que funcionan muy bien y se esfuerzan por ayudarte. Uno de los chicos de recepción sí hablaba muy bien inglés y nos ayudó mucho.
El metro no está muy cerca, hay que caminar como 20 minutos, pero los didi (taxis) son muy baratos y te recogen en la puerta.
El día que nos íbamos, teníamos nuestro vuelo por la tarde y les dijimos que si podíamos hacer el check out más tarde de las 12 y sin ningún problema ni coste adicional nos pudimos quedar has las 15:00.
Nos alojamos en este hotel al inicio y al final de nuestro viaje. En uno de los casos la habitación daba para la zona interior (jardín muy amplio) y en la otra daba para la entrada principal (carretera), en ambos casos en plantas altas. Recomiendo la zona interior porque en la exterior se escucha el ruido del tráfico y los pitidos.

Upside_Review:

Downside_Review:
Reservamos y pagamos por una habitación doble y nos dieron la habitación para una persona...
Nada más llegar dejamos las maletas y nos dimos cuenta de que era algo pequeña, pero nos fuimos y no le dimos mayor importancia. A la vuelta, nos dimos cuenta de que para estar dos personas en la habitación teníamos que estar haciendo malabares y, para rematar, al meternos en la cama, además de que la cama era algo pequeña (mi pareja mide 1,83m) nos dimos cuenta de que no podíamos arroparnos los dos, nos habían puesto el edredón para una persona.
Habíamos reservado este hotel porque unos familiares y conocidos se habían hospedado y tuvieron muy buena experiencia. Decidimos escribirles para comentarles lo que nos sucedía y les pareció raro, por eso pensamos que tal vez fue un mal entendido o un error en la reserva...
Cuando lo dijimos en recepción, nos ofrecieron otro edredón y también nos enseñaron una habitación más grande. Una vez en la habitación, nos dijeron que tenía un suplemento porque era superior. Fue un poco desagradable la situación la verdad. Finalmente dijimos que sí porque en la otra habitación no estábamos cómodos.
El encargado nos dijo que todas las habitaciones dobles estándar eran como la que nos dieron al llegar. Si eso es cierto, no os recomiendo que os hospedéis, la habitación era MUY PEQUEÑA.

Upside_Review: Pues diría que nada, solo la cama si eso, que es una sola grande.
Downside_Review: Muchas cosas no me gustaron. Primero de todo llegamos a las 23h aprox y lo último que esperábamos es que la habitación no estuviera en condiciones y nos tuviéramos que estar cambiando, todo agotados, muertos de sueños, cambiandonos de habitación una vez instalados. Por el motivo de que el baño estaba sucio, había un pelo cruzado en el váter donde te sientas y restos de sangre de la regla en el aro. También había toallas solo para una persona y en la reserva éramos dos. Llamo a recepción y me dicen que me cambian la habitación y yo ok cuelgo. Pasan 20min....nada, vuelvo a llamar, le digo si tengo que bajar o ellos suben, y me dicen que tenía que bajar yo, y digo, a ver si el fallo es de ellos, ya podrían subir a darnos el cambio de tarjeta en la habitación. Pues parece que se dieron cuenta de ello, y me dijeron que iban a subir, tardaron 10min, salimos y resulta que la habitación estaba al lado pasando dos puertas, y para eso querían que bajemos con todo abajo. Después entramos en la nueva habitación y ahí ya vi que había toalla para dos, menos mal. Luego la habitación es muy pequeña, tiene pocas luces, es incómodo a mi que me gusta todo iluminado. Luego queríamos sacar la ropa de las maletas y nuestras cosas para ponerlas en el armario y no había armario, tuvimos que abrir las maletas cada vez que queriamos cambiarnos de ropa. Porque no había espacio, había detrás de la puerta un sitio para perchas pero solo habían 4-5. Hacía mucho frío, menos mal que había calefacción aunque le costaba calentar. Por último el desayuno, jajaja, un poco triste. Nos quedábamos 4 días, y claro desayunar lo mismo cada día....en la zona de comida caliente siempre había lo mismo, huevos revueltos, patatas con verduras, porridge de plátano, tortitas, y huevo cocido que supuestamente ponía 5min cocido y ese huevo estaba más duro imposible, todo seco. De embutidos igual lo mismo siempre y poca cosa. Pero ya lo peor fue la fruta, eso me jodió bastante.

Upside_Review:
La ubicación. 
La relación calidad precio, teniendo en cuenta de que hablamos del centro de Madrid. Al lado de La Puerta del Sol, Palacio de Congresos, etc.
Habitación acogedora.
Downside_Review:
Nos gustó bastante en términos generales.
Si es verdad como dicen algunos comentarios, que las habitaciones son pequeñas, pero son bastante acogedoras y bien equipadas. Y disponen del espacio justo y necesario para estar cómodos. De todas formas una persona que coge una habitación a ese precio en el centro de Madrid no lo debería hacer para estar en la habitación, si no para patearse la ciudad y ir a la habitación a descansar nada más.
También hay algunos comentarios que hablan del ruido de la calle. El hotel da a dos calles y a un patio interior. El problema es que las habitaciones que dan a la calle principal (de entrada al hotel) tienen una discoteca justo enfrente que genera bastante ruido, principalmente por las personas que se apostan en la entrada. Nosotros por suerte nos toco una de las mejores habitaciones, daba a la calle que no hay tanto ruido, y era más luminosa que las que dan al patio interior. Igualmente se escuchaba algo de ruido, pero cerrando las ventanas y la persiana y poniendo el aire acondicionado, no se oía prácticamente nada.
Conclusión: podría repetir sin problemas, pero si la economía me lo permite, me gustaría quedarme en un hotel de más lujo, que por lo que pudimos ver y nos dijo el taxista están abriendo a cientos en la ciudad.

Upside_Review: La ubicación era maravillosa, cerca de la torre Eiffel y del palacio de congresos de Versalles. La cama es bastante cómoda también y la presión y la temporatura de la ducha genial
Downside_Review: La limpieza. La ausencia de limpieza en el edificio, las lámparas, suelo y terraza dejaban mucho que desear. Había telarañas en todas las lámparas de la habitación y el balcón daba miedo verlo. Cuando abríamos la ventana toda la mierda del balcón se metía dentro de la habitación. También el calor que pasamos en la habitación fue horrible. Tuvimos problemas con el código de la puerta un par de veces pero nos lo solucionaron rápidamente. Tuve que insistir bastante para conseguir la factura de la habitación dividida en dos con la mitad del precio para mi compañera y para mí porque no las pedían en el trabajo para reembolsarnos el dinero, aunque después de pedirla más de 5 veces la conseguí. Además, me retuvieron 200€ durante mi estancia para comprobar la validez de mi tarjeta de crédito. Ese pago no venía en ningún sitio cuando reservé la habitación e incluso a otros compañeros de trabajo que se hospedaron en el mismo sitio no se lo hicieron, solamente a mí y sin avisar. Conseguí contactar con ellos para preguntarles por qué me habían retenido solo a mí 200 euros demás, y me dijeron que por seguridad y que si quería el día del check-in me cobraban SOLO lo restante. Sin embargo, el día del check-in se cobraron la totalidad del precio de la habitación junto con esos 200€ que no me devolvieron hasta 5 días más tarde... En resumen, sitio con buena ubicación, pero atención al cliente y limpieza pésima.

Además, no tenían de muchas cosas que traía la carta (ya pequeña de por sí), una chica fue a cenar y se fue sin consumir nada porque no tenían nada de variedad. No recomiendo el bar en la hora de tarde-noche ni con el descuento del 50%, lo siento.

Elegí este hotel por 1) Comentarios muy positivos acerca de la limpieza. 2) El desayuno "delicious" (palabras textuales). 3) La terraza de la azotea. 
Llegué una noche de lluvia y encontré el recibidor lúgubre y con goteras. Pensé que lo importante eran las habitaciones y continué. Llegué a mi planta y la moqueta era para salir corriendo, además de que olía a comida y eso que estaba 8 pisos por encima del piso del desayuno. Y pensé de nuevo: lo importante es la habitación.
Pues bien, el estado de la habitación dejaba que desear. Encontré restos de comida en el suelo, mancha de café en la mesa, y las paredes necesitaban una buena pintada. Lo peor, el baño: la típica cabina de los Ibis pero olía a orina. No me quité las chanclas en ningún momento, ni para entrar a ducharme.
Finalmente: Sólo se ofrece desayuno los fines de semana!!!! La azotea es de uso libre pero no cuenta con bar/restaurante.

Downside_Review: 首先，作为一家高级精品酒店，这里的设备设施却相当陈旧，与其宣传的形象严重不符。其次，尽管酒店的地理位置位于市中心，但酒店却没有免费停车场，让太过依赖车辆出行的我感到不便。最不可容忍的是，酒店的卫生状况差强人意，清洁工作做得并不彻底，浴室内有难以忍受的味道。餐饮质量也算不上多好，选择少之又少。对于这个价格，我不认为值得。

Upside_Review: 北京维景国际大酒店位于市区中心，交通极为便利，到故宫、天安门都非常近，步行只需10-15分钟。酒店设施现代化，房间宽敞舒适，床铺软硬适中，保证了我良好的睡眠。酒店的服务态度非常好，热情周到，让我感到宾至如归。
Downside_Review: 没有什么特别不满意的地方，只觉得早餐的种类还可以更丰富些。

Upside_Review: 餐饮格局桥好

Upside_Review: 酒店的位置还算可以，离地铁站比较近，出行比较方便。
Downside_Review: 酒店的设施比较旧，需要翻新。服务员的态度也有待提高，处理顾客问题的效率不高。此外，房间的隔音效果不好，晚上经常被隔壁的噪音打扰。餐厅的饭菜种类也比较单一，没有很多选择。

Upside_Review: 该酒店设计别致且富有怀旧风情，服务人员态度非常好。
Downside_Review: 无

Upside_Review: 酒店的设计风格不错，宿神室样板人气趴

Upside_Review: 這家酒店的裝飾典雅，客房服務非常熱情並且專業，位置也相當便利，坐落在中央商務區
Downside_Review: 總的來說，我沒有找到任何值得批評的地方，這次入住體驗非常好

Upside_Review: 地理位置优缘

Upside_Review: 酒店的地理位置非常优越，交通十分便利

Hotel Name: 北京上地智选假日酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的位置十分便利，交通方便，且靠近很多餐馆和购物区。客房整洁舒适，设施齐全。酒店员工非常友善，服务也很周到。
Downside_Review: 虽然总体很好，但酒店的早餐选择比较有限，可以增加一些更多元化的选项。

Hotel Name: 北京上地智选假日酒店
Upside_Review: 占地面廣，空间風格不差。
Downside_Review: 前往醉酒的味道很重，客房不够清潔，浴室里面有马案和潮濕，没有任何美焉日用品；床做着非常不舒服，床回很有防辣味，跑往电梯的走廊废气难闻，似乎微微暑热恐怕体验，前台服务小姐也不太认真的

Hotel Name: 北京上地智选假日酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的位置还算不错
Downside_Review: 房间干净度和设施十分欠佳，服务态度也需要改进

Hotel Name: 北京临空智选假日酒店
Upside_Review: 这家酒店位置优越，靠近机场，非常适合需要早班飞机或者来北京转机的朋友。酒店有免费的机场接送服务，司机服务态度极好，非常准时。房间整洁、舒适，设施也很新，特别是床和床上用品的质量都非常高。早餐品种丰富，包括各类中式和西式的选择，品质也很好。酒店工作人员服务态度都非常友好，乐于提供帮助。
Downside_Review: 周围相对较偏，夜晚可能会觉得比较清静，如果想出去寻找夜生活或者购物可能会觉得不便，没有多少餐厅或便利店可供选择。酒店内的餐饮价格比较高，所以建议酒店能推出更多的餐饮优惠方案。

Hotel Name: 北京临空智选假日酒店
Upside_Review: 地点离机场近，有班车，适合赶早班飞机的旅客。
Downside_Review: 由于酒店地处偏僻，周边没有便利商店和餐馆，非常不方便。房间设施陈旧，卫生状况一般。

Hotel Name: 北京临空智选假日酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店地理位置近机场，交通直接，通行方便
Downside_Review: 房间干净情况平平，设施较为老化，不如常见的酒店弹毫丰富，服务人员的服务不算为热情借谅

Hotel Name: 北京英协万达嘉华酒店
Upside_Review: 1. 酒店设施舒适现代，尤其是室内游泳池和健身房，是我每天放松的好地方。2. 酒店的地理位置非常方便，紧邻购物中心和很多地道美食餐厅。3. 室内环境非常好，窗外的视野开阔，可以欣赏到北京城市的风景。4. 酒店的服务人员也非常热情周到，让我有宾至如归的感觉。
Downside_Review: 1. 酒店的Wi-Fi信号有些弱，上网速度不是很快。2. 嘈杂的城市噪声有时会影响到休息。

Hotel Name: 北京英协万达嘉华酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的装饰款式颇具特色，位置也是相当便利。
Downside_Review: 但是，房间的清洁情况让人有些失望，尤其是卫生间。另外，早餐的品种比想象的要少多了，选择余地并不大。最后，服务员的服务态度并不热情，让客户感觉欠缺了一些热情的欢迎。

Hotel Name: 北京英协万达嘉华酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的外观和大堂整体设计还是不错的
Downside_Review: 房间内设施陈旧，明显感觉没有按时进行养护和更新。服务人员的态度也不尽如人意，包括前台、楼层服务员甚至是餐厅的工作人员。此外，酒店的早餐菜单单一，无论是品种还是口味都无法满足我们的需求。

Hotel Name: 北京海淀永泰福朋喜来登酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的地理位置优越，紧邻购物中心和旅游景点，非常便利。房间格局设计合理，设施齐全，床铺舒适。酒店的员工热情友善，服务周到。
Downside_Review: 膳食选择相对较少，希望能增加多元化的餐食选择。

Hotel Name: 北京海淀永泰福朋喜来登酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店位置相对较为便利，周边交通也较为便捷。但是有几项内容确实让我十分失望……
Downside_Review: 首先，入住时工作人员的服务态度极其冷淡，完全没有感受到该有的欢迎感。其次，房间内部设施旧金山，尤其是卫生间的卫生状况有待提升。最重要的是，我预订的房间应该附带早餐，但入住当天我却被告知没有这项服务，我感到非常困扰。

Hotel Name: 北京海淀永泰福朋喜来登酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的地理位置不错，近期许多酒店都涨价了，

Hotel Name: 北京天地华典酒店式公寓（悠乐汇店）
Upside_Review: 酒店位置不错
Downside_Review: 酒店内部装修陈旧，床铺不够干净。通风设备不良，房间内充满了霉味。酒店服务人员态度冷淡，缺少专业性。

Hotel Name: 北京天地华典酒店式公寓（悠乐汇店）
Upside_Review: 酒店式公寓位置优越，靠近地铁站，购物和餐饮也很方便。用餐区域吸引人，种类丰富，服务态度也很好。
Downside_Review: 一进入房间，就闻到一股强烈的霉味，甚至可以看到墙上有霉斑。尽管我多次请求酒店工作人员进行清理，但他们的回应不仅缓慢，而且还未能彻底解决问题。除此之外，公寓设施陈旧，尤其是卫生间硬件设施，显示出明显的磨损痕迹，对我来说影响了住宿体验。此外，洗涤用品的质量非常低，使用后皮肤觉得非常干燥。我预定的房间类型显示是有厨房的，但实际上并没有提供相关用具，让我感到失望。总的来说，尽管地理位置很好，但是硬件设施和服务都让我感到失望。

Hotel Name: JEN北京新国贸饭店-香格里拉集团
Upside_Review: 此酒店地理位置优越，位于北京市中心。员工服务态度非常好，早餐种类多样，味道非常美。房间设施也很完善，非常舒适。
Downside_Review: 没有明显的问题。

Hotel Name: JEN北京新国贸饭店-香格里拉集团
Upside_Review: 1. 酒店的地理位置相当不错，靠近新国贸，出行相当便利。2. 酒店的装修设计具有现代感，给人感觉很舒服。3. 客房内设施齐全，舒适度相当高。

Hotel Name: Stey酒店（北京天安门王府井店）
Upside_Review: 以为在国外见过类似的酒店，没想到中国也有同样的概念。如果你是个时尚的、追求生活品质的人，我相信这个地方会很适合你。酒店的设计舒适，现代，房间内的设施一应俱全，更是整齐且干净。服务人员非常友好热情，总是保持微笑并及时为你解决任何问题。地理位置也非常棒，步行几分钟就可以到达王府井步行街和天安门广场。
Downside_Review: 唯一的问题是酒店的价格较高，不过考虑到他的地理位置和服务，我觉得这个价钱是可以接受的。

Hotel Name: Stey酒店（北京天安门王府井店）

Upside_Review: 服务人员非常友好和乐于帮助。乐于提供旅游建议或帮助您预订活动。房间的设计和装饰十分现代且放松。
Downside_Review: 虽然早餐非常美味，但种类稍微有些欠缺。而且有时在高峰期，你可能需要等待一些时间才能有位置。

Upside_Review: 地理位置优越，交通非常便利，周边美食丰富

Hotel Name: 北京什刹海皮影文化主题酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店的设计太有特色了，非常有中国传统文化的气息，服务也非常周到，位置方便，我非常喜欢这个酒店
Downside_Review: 无

Hotel Name: 北京什刹海皮影文化主题酒店
Downside_Review: 服务态度差，酒店清洁不彻底，音隔效果差，附近环境嘈杂。

Hotel Name: 北京燕莎中心凯宾斯基饭店
Upside_Review: 北京燕莎中心凯宾斯基饭店的体验非常棒。从前台接待的服务态度，到客房清洁的细致程度，都给我留下了深刻的印象。住宿环境优美，设施齐全，位于城市中心，购物和交通都非常方便。特别值得一提的是，他们的早餐种类丰富，品质上乘，十分美味。我在这里的每一个夜晚都睡得非常好，感到十分放松舒适。
Downside_Review: 没有什么具体可以指出的缺点。

Hotel Name: 北京燕莎中心凯宾斯基饭店
Upside_Review: 位置优越，出门就是燕莎购物中心，购物方便。酒店大堂很气派，房间内的设施也比较完整。
Downside_Review: 酒店的服务人员态度不够亲切，尤其是前台的工作人员，缺乏耐心解答客户问题。房间的清洁度也不尽如人意，发现有灰尘和头发。另外，房间的隔音效果很差，经常能听到楼道内的吵闹声，影响休息。早餐品种有限，口味也比较一般。

Hotel Name: 北京锦绣庄四合院宾馆
Upside_Review: 非常有北京特色的宾馆，环境优雅清静，整体环境和设施都十分满意。四合院的建筑格局十分吸引人，体现了浓郁的中国传统文化。房间布置精致而又宽敞，床铺柔软舒适。员工热情友善，服务周到，每天都贴心地提供了果盘。
Downside_Review: 位置稍显偏僻，要去繁华的商业区需要一段路程。另外，早餐种类相对较少，希望能增加一些品种。

Hotel Name: 北京锦绣庄四合院宾馆
Upside_Review: 酒店所处的环境非常宁静，四合院风格的设施展现了北京独特的传统文化，让人感到非常亲切。
Downside_Review: 酒店房间的清洁工作做得不够仔细，我在浴室里找到了前一个客人留下的毛巾。饭店的味道也不如我期待的好，食物的选择有些单调，吃起来不够满意。此外，前台的服务员态度并不友好，给我留下了不好的印象，我觉得他们需要改进他们的服务。

Hotel Name: 北京金融街丽思卡尔顿酒店
Upside_Review: 北京金融街丽思卡尔顿酒店的位置真的非常好。酒店的设施非常全面，游泳池，健身房，SPA都非常棒。服务人员的态度也特别热情。
Downside_Review: 唯一的小缺点可能就是价格有点高。但是考虑到这个酒店的地理位置和设施，这个价格也是可以接受的。

Hotel Name: 北京金融街丽思卡尔顿酒店
Upside_Review: 酒店之前可能是一盛一营时，但现在感觉管理来不及他酒店
Downside_Review: 非常提心，光线不好、门童人员态度不好，但主要是房间太老了。有一种压把人的感觉，可能是因为多次被烟雾感枢吊异味或者如主卧手奔哈哈的感觉，家具和室内棵花都是太老了。

Hotel Name: base佰舍服务式公寓（北京工体店）
Upside_Review: 公寓地理位置优越，距离三里屯，朝阳公园非常近，周围美食众多，是美食探索者的首选。我们入住的房间设施完备且干净明亮，服务人员态度也非常友善，给我们提供了很多有帮助的信息，使我们的行程更加顺利。
Downside_Review: 晚上周围可能会有一些嘈杂的音乐声，如果你是轻度睡眠者，可能需要准备耳塞。

Hotel Name: base佰舍服务式公寓（北京工体店）
Downside_Review: 这家公寓的服务相当差，我在入住期间遇到了很多问题。首先，公寓内部装修陈旧，家具和家电明显已经过时，厨房设施也不齐全，这给我在居住过程中带来了很多不便。其次，公寓的清洁程度也令我大失所望，从地面到床单都能看到明显的脏污。再者，公寓的隔音效果也非常差，楼上的动静我都能听得一清二楚，这严重影响了我休息。最后，公寓的服务人员态度冷淡，还在我退房时要求额外付费，对此我感到非常愤怒。总的来说，我对这次入住体验感到非常失望，我不会推荐这个公寓给任何人。

Upside_Review: 房間寬敞舒適、早餐種類豐富、位置靠近市中心。
Downside_Review: 偶爾會覺得客滿、附近車流量大。

The Hotel Ickale is a splendid choice for any traveler in Ankara. With its spacious, comfortable rooms and a welcoming, helpful staff, it truly made my stay enjoyable. Breakfast was delicious with a wide variety to fit anyone's palate.

Upside_Review: The hotel leaves a pleasant and comfortable impression. Its central location allows for easy access to attractions and services. The staff was welcoming and helpful, and the rooms were satisfactory in terms of comfort and cleanliness.
Downside_Review: The breakfast could have had a better variety, and the decor is a bit outdated.

Upside_Review: The hotel was nicely located with convenient access to major attractions. Staff was courteous and professional.
Downside_Review: The room service could be a bit faster, but it wasn’t really a big issue.

Upside_Review: Ickale Hotel has an excellent location, very near to some top attractions. Rooms are spacious and clean. The staff were fantastic, really going the extra mile to ensure everything was perfect. The food is delicious and varied. I would most definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Ankara.

The staff at Hotel Ickale in Ankara were extremely friendly and accommodating. I found the rooms to be quite spacious and the amenities were up to the standard. The hotel's location was also very convenient, offering easy access to the city's main attractions.
Downside_Review: The breakfast options were a bit limited, but still satisfactory.

Upside_Review: Good location
Downside_Review: Outdated rooms, unprofessional staff, and lacking quality in food services.

Upside_Review: The location was central
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the cleanliness was just not up to standard. I spotted dirt in several areas of my room, and the bathroom was not in the best condition either. The service was also lacking, with staff often seeming uninterested or unavailable. In this competitive industry, lack of attention to detail can seriously hinder a hotel's reputation. I cannot recommend this hotel and would advise other travelers to find another place to stay in Ankara.

Upside_Review: The breakfast had a nice variety of options and the restaurant on top of the hotel offers a great panoramic view of the city.
Downside_Review: There are a couple of issues I faced during my stay at Hotel Ickale. The air conditioning in the room was not working properly which made it uncomfortable during the night. Housekeeping wasn't up to par and could use improvement. Also, the walls seemed to have poor soundproofing, allowing me to hear all hallway noises.

Upside_Review: The hotel is located in city center which is a plus.
Downside_Review: The rooms can be better cleaned. The carpet was stained and the furniture is old. The food also lacked variety. Staff need to improve on their customer service skills.

Upside_Review: Central location, easy to reach major tourist sites and city center. Extremely clean rooms and professional staff
Downside_Review: Nothing to complain about

The staff were very attentive and went out of their way to make our stay memorable. The location is also a big plus, being central and within walking distance from shops, restaurants, and metro stations.

I can't say anything negative about the Hotel Cinnah in Ankara. Everybody is very friendly and tries to help you wherever they can. Breakfast is amazing! There's a wide variety of food which tastes as good as it looks. The rooms are extremely clean and the housekeeping does everything to keep it that way during your stay. Lovely city views from the higher floors, would definitely recommend!

Breakfast was a highlight, offering a variety of delicious local and international options. Its prime location, nestled in the heart of Ankara, made it easy to explore the city's vibrant offerings.
Downside_Review: My only critique would be the Wi-Fi connectivity, which was occasionally slow and unstable.

Upside_Review: The hotel location was fantastic, within walking distance to major attractions and public transport. The room was immaculate with daily cleaning. The staff was always ready with a smile and very helpful in helping us navigate the city. The breakfast spread was also bountiful and delicious!
Downside_Review: I enjoyed everything about this hotel, only downside was the noise from the traffic at night but it didn't affect our overall enjoyment of the hotel.

Upside_Review: Convenient location in the city center.
Downside_Review: Our room was extremely basic, felt like it was due for a renovation. The air conditioning was ineffective, which was difficult in the heat. Lastly, the breakfast was disappointing, with not enough variety for a hotel of this standard.

Upside_Review: Despite the poor overall experience, the hotel is centrally located which gives it easy access to local attractions.
Downside_Review: My stay at Hotel Cinnah in Ankara was marked by cleanliness issues, unsatisfactory food quality at the breakfast buffet, and a serious lack of proper customer service.

Upside_Review: Location was quite good, within walking distance to several attractions
Downside_Review: Overall, a very disappointing experience at Hotel Cinnah. There was a severe lack of customer service, staff members were generally unhelpful and unresponsive. The room itself, while clean, was not particularly comfortable - the bed was hard, and the air conditioning system was loud and made it difficult to sleep. Additionally, the Wi-Fi was slow and kept disconnecting. Breakfast was also quite poor with limited choices.

Upside_Review: The hotel was located close to the city's main attractions.
Downside_Review: The service at Hotel Cinnah was far from satisfactory. From the moment I checked in, the front desk staff was unhelpful and dismissive. The WiFi was frustratingly slow, making it impossible for me to get some necessary work done. The room was not cleaned properly, leaving a disappointing experience overall. I have to say that the facilities are pretty run down and could use serious refurbishment too.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location is convenient, right in the center of Ankara.

There seemed to be constant noise in the hallways, and the thin walls did little to keep it out. The room service menu was disappointing with limited options and the food quality was subpar. Additionally, the staff also lacked warmth and attentiveness.

Upside_Review: The hotel is ideally situated in the heart of Ankara which offers an easy access to the city's must-see destinations. The rooms are comfortable and clean, the breakfast is great with a variety of choices. Staff are friendly and go out of their way to ensure guests have everything they need.
Downside_Review: The only downside would be the traffic during peak hours in the city, but that is no fault of the hotel. A bit noises from nearby rooms can sometimes be heard.

Upside_Review: The hotel was located conveniently and offered decent amenities. Staff were cordial and helpful.
Downside_Review: The breakfast could do with a little more variety.

Upside_Review: The New Park Hotel in Ankara offers comprehensive services and a friendly staff. The complimentary breakfast selection was excellent, and I appreciated the spacious, well-furnished rooms. Its location is also convenient, being in close proximity to historically significant sites and local shopping.
Downside_Review: However, the fitness facilities, while clean, could do with some upgrading to match the high standards of the rest of the establishment.

Upside_Review: The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Ankara. The staff were extremely friendly and the breakfast was delicious. Rooms were clean and spacious.
Downside_Review: The WiFi connection was occasionally unstable.

Upside_Review: Pleasant and helpful staff, clean and comfortable rooms. Provides everything you need for a comfortable stay.

The central location of the New Park Hotel in Ankara could not be beaten. The proximity to local attractions and transportation was ideal for travel purposes and providing some options for venturing out into the city.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the hotel's prime location could not make up for the negatives we found. Our stay at the New Park Hotel was marred by unclean rooms, poor service, and uncomfortable beds. The wifi consistently failed and made it difficult to plan our daily excursions. In addition, the breakfast buffet was below average with not much variety and the surroundings weren’t kept clean. Moreover, the staff seemed indifferent to our complaints about the rooms and service, which made our stay more frustrating.

Upside_Review: Hotel was in a generally good location
Downside_Review: Rooms were outdated and not as clean as they should have been. Staff was not very responsive to concerns.

Upside_Review: The New Park Hotel is situated in a very convenient location within Ankara.
Downside_Review: Sadly, the hotel did not meet our expectations. Unmaintained facilities, outdated decor, and lack of cleanliness were significant issues. Customer service was also far from adequate. We were disappointed with the value for money.

Upside_Review: The location was decently close to some major attractions and the staff were quite polite and accommodating.
Downside_Review: The room itself was a bit disappointing. The carpet looked worn out and the bathroom wasn't as clean as I would have liked. Additionally, the breakfast was rather plain with limited variety. Soundproofing was also an issue, I was able to hear the noise from the corridor during the night.

Upside_Review: Location
Downside_Review: Paying for the internet is a bit of a downer, given the fact that it's almost a given at most places to have free Wi-Fi. Plus, the rooms were a bit on the smaller side.

Upside_Review: Beautiful location, excellent amenities and friendly staff

The Green Park Ankara is truly a jewel of a hotel. The rooms are spacious and well appointed, and the staff is superb. Their kindness and attention to detail really make for a pleasant stay. Furthermore, the location is excellent, providing easy access to the heart of Ankara. Highly recommended for any stay.
Downside_Review: None

Upside_Review: Loved the spacious and comfortable rooms along with the fantastic view. The hotel was very clean and well maintained.
Downside_Review: The staff could improve their English skills to provide better service for international guests. Ideally, they should have clear instructions in English for the buffet, pool and other facilities.

Upside_Review: The Green Park Ankara offers top notch service, comfortable beds and a wonderful buffet breakfast. The central location was quite convenient for exploring the city.
Downside_Review: The WiFi was a bit spotty at times in the room, much better in the common areas.

Upside_Review: Spacious rooms, professional staff, comfortable bed and delicious food, peaceful environment. This hotel is just perfect!
Downside_Review: None!

Upside_Review: Service was polite
Downside_Review: The rooms are outdated and poorly maintained, with worn out furniture and appliances. The cleanliness was also not up to standard, with dust in some corners and a lingering smell of smoke, even though it was a non-smoking room. The food at the hotel restaurant was mediocre at best, lacking in flavor and variety.

Upside_Review: The location was alright, near some stores and parks.
Downside_Review: The worst thing about the stay was the uncomfortable rooms. The air conditioning seemed old and was very noisy, which made it hard to sleep. The bed was also quite stiff and the pillows offered little support. Moreover, the cleanliness was a concern. There were hairs in the bathroom and dust under the bed. Lastly, the staff was not friendly or attentive. It was difficult to communicate with them and they failed to promptly respond to the problems.

Upside_Review: The lobby was beautifully designed.
Downside_Review: The room was extremely outdated with an uncomfortable bed, the customer service was unresponsive, and the amenities promised were not as they claimed.

Upside_Review: The hotel has a decent location in the city.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, my stay at The Green Park Ankara was underwhelming. From an unimpressive welcome by the front desk staff to the lackluster cleanliness in the room, the hotel certainly under-delivered. The bed was not as comfy as one would expect from such a reputation, and the noise from the street didn't help in providing a good night's sleep. The breakfast spread was barely passable, and although the hotel boasted of several amenities, a lot of them seemed to be constantly under maintenance. Despite being located in the heart of Ankara, the disappointing service and experience dampened the overall experience.

Upside_Review: Staff at the reception speak English, breakfast was varied.
Downside_Review: From outdated rooms to subpar food quality. The place badly needs an overhaul. The rooms are not clean as they should be, found several hairs in bathroom and a stain on one of the towels. The pool area was also not very clean. The wifi connection was horrible, barely able to load emails. Unfortunately, wouldn't recommend it to others until these issues are addressed.

Upside_Review: The Grand Mercure Hotel in Ankara was a total gem. The staff was friendly and hospitable, going out of their way to ensure our stay was comfortable. The room was clean, spacious, with a luxurious touch - quality bedding and modern decoration. The buffet breakfast was included - it was an interesting mix of local and international cuisine. The location was superb - close to the business district and major attractions. I would certainly recommend this hotel to anyone travelling to Ankara.
Downside_Review: Nothing noteworthy. Just a little bit more variety in the breakfast menu would have been cherry on top!

Upside_Review: Grand Mercure Ankara exhibits a beautiful blend of traditional styles and modern comforts to guarantee a fulfilling stay. Situated in an excellent location, this hotel features spacious, stylistic rooms, and warm, welcoming staff who are ready to meet your every need. Its proximity to a variety of attractions makes it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers.
Downside_Review: Despite its marked beauty, I noted a bit of traffic noise due to its location. But this was only during peak hours and didn’t affect the overall charm of the hotel.

Upside_Review: The Grand Mercure Ankara stands out for its exceptional customer service, spacious rooms, and gourmet dining. The hotel's location in the heart of Ankara makes it an ideal choice for both business travellers and vacationers.
Downside_Review: While the hotel prides itself on keeping up-to-date, some areas feel a little dated and could benefit from a modern makeover. Double confirmation for reservations could also be streamlined for smoother customer experience.

Upside_Review: A wonderful stay set in a great location! Service was fantastic and the food was pure culinary brilliance. The room was pristine and comfortable with an unmatched view.
Downside_Review: The WiFi was slightly slow and had occasional disconnects.

Upside_Review: Excellent hotel in the heart of Ankara. The rooms are spacious and clean, with comfortable beds. The staff was friendly and helpful. Highly recommend this hotel for both work and leisure.
Downside_Review: I wish they had more vegetarian options on their menu.

Upside_Review: The view from the hotel room was pretty impressive, giving a wide panorama of Ankara.
Downside_Review: However, the hotel overall was pretty disappointing. The rooms were dated and in dire need of renovation. The Wi-Fi was extremely patchy and made it almost impossible to get any work done. The staff, although friendly, were not very responsive to requests or complaints.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location is great. Really close to the city center.
Downside_Review: The room was not up to standard. It was small and poorly maintained. The staff were not helpful when we encountered problems. The services promised were not delivered and the overall experience was quite disappointing.

Upside_Review: Great city views from the upper floors
Downside_Review: The hotel seemed rather outdated. The room I stayed in had several issues related to plumbing. Check-in process was longer than expected

Upside_Review: The location is quite central, but that's about it.
Downside_Review: Unpleasant smell in the rooms and the corridors, slow wifi and not so clean bathrooms.

Upside_Review: Positives were the proximity to the central parts of Ankara
Downside_Review: The outdated rooms were disappointing with poor air quality and ventilation. The service was less than ideal and could definitely use improvement. The overall amenities were also lacking compared to other hotels in the area.

Upside_Review: At Esila Hotel in Ankara, I found the rooms to be significantly spacious, clean, and comfortable. The breathtaking view of the city from my room always felt like icing on the cake. The location is a definite winner - it's in close vicinity to several essential hotspots like the Kocatepe Mosque and Ataturk Cultural Center, which made exploring the city incredibly effortless. The hotel staff were courteous and ever-willing to assist, whilst the added availability of a translator was a thoughtful touch. The buffet breakfast was vast and delicious, offering everything from various breads, jams, cheeses, fruits, fresh vegetables, scrambled eggs to flavorful Turkish tea.
Downside_Review: Only minor downside was the noise from the busy city, but that's unavoidable given the central location.

Upside_Review: Great hospitality, clean rooms, fantastic location
Downside_Review: WiFi connection could be improved

Upside_Review: The rooms were spacious and clean, and the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel in the city center was very convenient, allowing easy access to local attractions.
Downside_Review: The buffet breakfast could have a wider variety, especially for those with dietary restrictions.

Upside_Review: The Esila Hotel has an excellent location, delicious breakfast, and extremely courteous staff
Downside_Review: The WiFi was a bit inconsistent. It would be great if it was more reliable.

Upside_Review: Esila Hotel offers genuinely friendly staff who are always ready to assist. It's in a great location, within walking distance of local attractions. The rooms are impeccably clean and the food is delicious.
Downside_Review: However, the WiFi could be a bit spotty at times, and the soundproofing isn't quite 100%. But overall, these were just minor drawbacks in an otherwise excellent stay.

Upside_Review: The only positive thing about Esila Hotel was its proximity to the city center.
Downside_Review: However, I am deeply disappointed with my stay at Esila Hotel, Ankara. The quality of the services offered was incredibly poor. The rooms were not clean, cluttered and had an unpleasant smell. To make matters worse, the hotel staff were not friendly and the language barrier made communication very difficult. The food was not tasty and lacked variety. Given these issues, I would not recommend Esila Hotel to other tourists.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location is fairly central and close to public transport, which was convenient.
Downside_Review: I have numerous disappointments from my stay. Firstly, the rooms felt very dated and could definitely use a facelift. Secondly, the cleanliness issue was a constant problem throughout my stay, there was dust and dirt in the corners of the room and the bathroom. Finally, their breakfast was underwhelming at best, with a lack of variety and freshness.

Upside_Review: The location of the Esila Hotel is good, as it is close to the city center and major attractions.
Downside_Review: Despite its great location, my experience at the Esila Hotel wasn't as expected. Firstly, the room I stayed in was in poor condition, paint was peeling off the walls and the furnishings were old and worn out. The in-room facilities were also lacking, with a faulty air conditioner and a shower that alternated between hot and cold. The hotel staff were less than helpful when it came to addressing these issues. Also, the hotel doesn't offer any sort of recreational activities or a fitness center, which was a big downside for me.

Upside_Review: The location was decent and the neighborhood seemed generally safe.
Downside_Review: The room was decidedly grubby, with visible stains on the sheets and cobwebs in the corners. The bathroom fixtures were ageing and the shower had very weak water pressure, making it difficult to wash properly. The breakfast was bland and lacked variety. Plus, service quality was very inconsistent; some staff members were polite and helpful, while others were standoffish and rude. Overall, the hotel doesn't offer good value for the price.

Upside_Review: The lobby was well-decorated and the central location was convenient.
Downside_Review: Customer service was lacking. The room was quite dirty upon check-in, especially the bathroom. The food served during breakfast was stale and the noise from the street was quite disturbing, leading to a bad sleep experience.

Upside_Review: The Inn 14 Hostel in Ankara offered a lovely experience with a homey atmosphere. Its rooms were spacious and clean with comfortable beds. The staff were caring and friendly, always ready to give advice about the city's attractions. Its location is ideal, allowing easy access to local eateries, shops, and the city center.
Downside_Review: Wi-Fi connection could improve, as it was slightly unstable in the rooms. Regardless of this minor detail, the experience was wonderful overall.

Upside_Review: The hostel staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. The location was superb, right in the heart of the city. The rooms were clean and well-maintained.
Downside_Review: The beds were a bit hard, but still manageable.

Upside_Review: Hotel Inn 14 Hostel in Ankara offered a delightful stay with its extremely friendly staff and incredibly clean facilities. The location is also very convenient, close to major sights and public transportation.
Downside_Review: It would have been better if there were more dining options in the vicinity of the hotel.

Upside_Review: The staff are impeccable with their service - always willing to help out and going above and beyond to ensure comfort. Plus, the cleanliness standards are top-notch.
Downside_Review: The rooms could have a bit more space and the internet connection was inconsistent at times.

Upside_Review: The Inn 14 Hostel provides a comfortable and cozy stay experience with its warm atmosphere and friendly staff. The location is great, close to many points of interest in Ankara.
Downside_Review: Wi-Fi was a bit inconsistent at times, but not a major issue.

Upside_Review: The staff was helpful and friendly
Downside_Review: The room was damp, there was a lack of sound insulation and Wi-Fi was inconsistent

Upside_Review: Convenient location and friendly staff.
Downside_Review: The rooms were poorly ventilated, making it stifling during the night. Also, the breakfast was quite limited and not very appetizing. Lastly, the noise from the street was bothersome and I found it difficult to get a good night's rest.

Upside_Review: The location of the Inn 14 Hostel in Ankara is quite good, being centrally located, and the lobby has a welcoming environment.
Downside_Review: It was quite a disappointing experience staying at the Inn 14 Hostel. The rooms were small and not maintained properly. The heating system was not working well, leading to an uncomfortable night. Additionally, the staff seemed unprofessional, and their lack of prompt service was quite disheartening. The noise from the adjacent street was also disturbing, making it difficult to rest properly.

Upside_Review:
+Location is prime
+Budget friendly
Downside_Review:
-The rooms were not clean enough. Dust everywhere and the bathroom was way too dirty
-The staff could not communicate well in English which led to several misunderstandings
-The noise levels from outside was so high that it became very hard to sleep
-The hostel had a very limited selection for breakfast and the quality was below average

Upside_Review:

Close proximity to main attractions.
Downside_Review:
Communication was tough as the staff had limited English skills.
Bed linen was not particularly clean.
Insufficient bathroom facilities for the number of guests.
No common room or social area for guests to interact.

Upside_Review: Superb service from staff, spectacular views from higher floors, spacious and ultra clean rooms, proximity to various important landmarks
Downside_Review: The breakfast menu could do with more variety

Upside_Review: Güvenay Business Hotel in Ankara provided a wonderful experience. I found the staff to be exceptionally friendly and the rooms clean and comfortable. The location in the business district was also quite convenient. I would highly recommend this hotel.
The rooms were clean and comfortable, the location of the hotel is very desirable for business travelers. Excellent customer service.
Downside_Review: No significant downside to mention

Upside_Review: The staff was extremely helpful and accommodating. Clean and well-furnished rooms. Central location with easy access to public transport.
Downside_Review: The breakfast offerings could be more varied.

Upside_Review: Clean rooms, friendly staff, and great location
Downside_Review: Lack of variety in food options

Upside_Review: The location is pretty central, great for business travellers.
Downside_Review: Firstly, the beds are really uncomfortable and hard as a rock, resulting in a poor night's sleep. The bathroom wasn't that clean, and the shower was barely functional. Lastly, the hotel staff had some serious communication problems. Not all the staff could speak even basic English, which made it difficult to address any queries.

Upside_Review: The hotel is situated in a good location in Ankara, offering easy access to the city. The price was also reasonable.
Downside_Review: The rooms left a lot to be desired. The furniture and overall decor looked outdated, giving the room a drab feeling. The cleanliness wasn't up to the mark either; there were dust bunnies underneath the beds, and the bathroom lacked essential toiletries. Additionally, the noise from the street was quite disruptive, and the lack of soundproofing only exacerbated this issue. The breakfast was underwhelming, with a limited range and quantity of food.

Upside_Review: The staff at the Güvenay Business Hotel were polite and the location is quite convenient.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the overall stay was unsatisfactory. The room was not cleaned properly, there was a constant noise from the street and the breakfast did not meet my expectations. The wifi connection was also poor.

Upside_Review: Central location
Downside_Review: The room was too small, the heating didn't work properly and the hotel staff was unresponsive to our complaints.

Upside_Review: The location of the hotel was ideal, being in the center of Ankara; the room was clean.
Downside_Review: The staff could use a bit more training, they seemed inexperienced. Also, the noise from the nearby bars was quite loud during nights, which made it difficult to sleep.

Upside_Review: The ibis Ankara Airport Hotel was a very convenient location for those arriving or departing at odd hours due to its close proximity to the airport. The staff was very considerate, understanding, and went out of their way to make sure my stay was comfortable. The breakfast was also a noteworthy feature with a decent variety of dishes. Rooms were clean and efficient, with a quiet atmosphere which was great for relaxing after a long journey.
Downside_Review: The rooms could use a bit of an update as some of the furnishings seemed a bit old and worn out. Also, the hotel might not be the most ideal if you are looking to explore central Ankara, as it's quite a distance away.

Upside_Review: The convenience of location was remarkable with just a few minutes distance from the airport. The staff were friendly and extremely helpful. The rooms were very clean and comfortable, quite conducive to a good night’s sleep after a long flight.
Downside_Review: Most of the TV channels were in Turkish without options for English subtitles or dubbing.

Upside_Review: The hotel is conveniently located near the airport, just a few minutes drive away. The staff were helpful and efficient. My room was clean, quiet, and comfortable, perfect for short overnight stays. The breakfast buffet was also quite decent with a variety of options.
Downside_Review: There were not many dining options around, as the hotel is located in an industrial area. Additionally, the shuttle service to the airport could be improved.

Upside_Review: The proximity to the airport was ideal. Efficient service, clean and comfortable room. Had a restful night before my flight!
Downside_Review: Do wish they had more variety in the restaurant menu. A bit limited for my tastes, nonetheless, the food was decently good.

Upside_Review: Easy access to the airport, perfect for early flights. Staff were amicable and always ready to assist. The rooms were clean, comfortable and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Downside_Review: The restaurant menu could be a bit more varied, but this was a minor issue considering the overall excellent service.

Upside_Review: The bed was comfortable.
Downside_Review: Despite being close to the airport, the noise levels from the airplanes were intolerable. The staff didn't seem to care about the guests' satisfaction, and customer service was poor. The rooms were also inadequately cleaned, making our stay uncomfortable.

Upside_Review: Proximity to the airport was beneficial, making travel quite easy.
Downside_Review: The rooms were notably small and the food options at the hotel were limited.

Upside_Review: The hotel offers a good location near the airport, and the quick check-in process was appreciated.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the room and bathroom were unclean and the bed was extremely uncomfortable. To top it off, the hotel staff was unhelpful and somewhat rude during my stay.

Upside_Review: Close to the airport
Downside_Review: The rooms were tiny, and the beds were incredibly uncomfortable. They had a terrible smell of smoke despite being a non-smoking room. The food at the restaurant was underwhelming and overpriced. To top it all off, the noise from the airport kept us awake all night.

Upside_Review: Conveniently located near the airport
Downside_Review: The rooms are quite small and service could be improved

Upside_Review: Extremely comfortable beds, excellent breakfast buffet, and very friendly and helpful staff.
Downside_Review: The gym was a bit limited in terms of equipment.

Upside_Review: Really enjoyed the spacious rooms and great view of the city.
Downside_Review: Can't think of any.

Upside_Review: Incredibly comfortable rooms, exquisite cuisine, and friendly staff that's always willing to help. The hotel is located in the Central Business District, making it highly convenient.
Downside_Review: Sometimes, the high number of guests can cause the elevators to get a bit crowded. But nothing too bothersome.

Upside_Review: Great location with easy access to attractions, excellent services from friendly and accommodating staff.
Downside_Review: No complaints found during my stay.

Upside_Review: Everything about the Raymar Hotels Ankara was top-notch. The rooms were spacious and clean, the staff was friendly and always ready to help, and the food was simply delicious. The location was also a major plus, with easy accessibility to major tourist spots.
Downside_Review: Honestly, I struggle to find any major downsides to this hotel. It surpassed all my expectations.

Upside_Review: Nearby public transportation access
Downside_Review: Disappointing room service, lack of cleanliness, unresponsive staff

Upside_Review: The impressive facade of Raymar Hotels Ankara indeed makes a promising first impression. The lobby area is amply spacious, filled with comfortable seating arrangements.
Downside_Review: Despite the grandeur, my stay was marred by numerous issues. Firstly, my room, though generally clean, had stains on the bathroom tiles and the bed linen was crumpled as if used. I asked for it to be changed but to no avail. The heating system in the room was faulty, leading to frosty nights. Worse yet, the promised high-speed Wi-Fi barely functioned which severely disrupted my work meetings. Moreover, the staff, though polite, lacked efficiency and commitment in solving any of the above mentioned issues. The food quality was mediocre with limited vegetarian options.

Upside_Review: The only redeeming feature of the hotel was its convenient location and the fairly comfortable beds.
Downside_Review: I had problems with the cleanliness of the hotel. The rooms were not properly cleaned and the towels and bed sheets weren't changed on a daily basis. The walls were thin, making it noisy, particularly at night. The dining area was unimpressive with limited selection of food. The hotel staff, while friendly, was not very responsive and oftentimes, inefficient. Their customer service needs significant improvement.

Upside_Review: Nothing. Horrible experience.
Downside_Review: Bad customer service, rooms were not clean and the food was below average.

Upside_Review: The staff was friendly and the location was conveniently close to the city center.
Downside_Review: However, the hotel's overall cleanliness needs major improvement, particularly in the bathrooms where there were signs of mildew. The noise level was also quite high, resulting in a lack of proper sleep.

Upside_Review: The Novotel Beijing Peace is located in a convenient part of town, near to shopping and dining areas. The room was clean, comfortable and spacious. It was also equipped with a modern and functional bathroom. The staff were very friendly and helpful, providing excellent service.
Downside_Review: The only downside was the breakfast dining area. It's a bit small and can get congested during peak hours.

Upside_Review: My stay at Novotel Beijing Peace was, in one word, amazing! The hotel staff was very courteous and helpful and they even assisted us with some valuable local travel tips. The breakfast buffet was diverse enough to meet my dietary preferences. Moreover, the room was very clean and comfortable, offering splendid city views.
Downside_Review: Perhaps the only downside I would indicate is the traffic noise during daytime, but I guess that's beyond the hotel's control.

Upside_Review: Fantastic stay at the Novotel Beijing Peace. The rooms were spacious and very clean, and the staff were super friendly and helpful. The location is superb, in the heart of the city, making access to major attractions a breeze. I particularly enjoyed the breakfast with a broad selection to cater to all tastes.
Downside_Review: The only small issue would be the limited English channels on the TV, but honestly, with so much to see and do in Beijing, we barely turned it on.

Upside_Review: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Novotel Beijing Peace. Its location is central and extremely convenient, being just a short stroll away from many major attractions such as the Forbidden City and the Wangfujing Shopping Street. The rooms were of a good size, clean and well-maintained, with a comfortable bed and a good selection of amenities. One particular highlight was the hotel's buffet breakfast – it had a diverse range of options, both Chinese and Western, and everything was fresh and delicious. The hotel also has a fitness center and indoor pool, which are well-maintained and much appreciated after a long day of sightseeing. The staff were consistently helpful and professional, and their effort to ensure that my stay was comfortable and enjoyable was very much appreciated.
Downside_Review: The only downside I could possibly add was a slight issue with the Wi-Fi in the room. It tended to disconnect intermittently, which made it a bit inconvenient for job-related work, but for general browsing it did the job.

Upside_Review: The location of Novotel Beijing Peace was perfect, within walking distance to the subway station and shopping malls. The rooms were clean and spacious with a comfortable bed. In addition, the staff was friendly and helpful throughout our stay.
Downside_Review: The only negative aspect might be that the internet connection was a bit slow

Upside_Review: The location is quite good, close to some tourist attractions
Downside_Review: The room was quite dated with clear signs of wear and tear. The cleanliness of the room left a lot to be desired as well. Service at the front desk was less than stellar.

Upside_Review: The location of Novotel Beijing Peace is commendable. It is in close proximity to the subway and shopping district. The lobby staff were welcoming and tried to help in any way they could.
Downside_Review: The hotel experience was less than satisfactory. The rooms were drab, poorly lit and not properly cleaned. The in-room amenities were severely lacking – the WiFi connectivity was poor, and the television had very limited English channels. Furthermore, communication with the majority of staff was quite challenging due to barriers in language. The dining options in the hotel were not satisfactory - the food was bland and undercooked. The price was not reflective of both the service and the accommodations provided.

Upside_Review: It has convenient location close to shopping district.
Downside_Review: Despite its prime location, the hotel rooms were extremely outdated. The WiFi was almost non-existent and the hotel staff was not cooperative. Room service was tardy and menu was not impressive. Overall, a disappointing stay.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location is quite convenient, providing easy access to local attractions and public transportation
Downside_Review: My stay at Novotel Beijing Peace was filled with disappointment from the start. The check-in was slow with staff that seemed disinterested. The amenities were not up to par with what you would expect from such a renowned chain - the carpeting in the rooms was old and stained, the TV had a rather limited selection of channels and the air conditioning did not work, which made for some uncomfortable nights. Furthermore, the noise from the street was quite disturbing even during the night. Lastly, the food served for breakfast at the restaurant was bland and lacked variety.

Upside_Review: Decent location and friendly staff
Downside_Review: Rooms seem to be outdated and smells of mildew somewhat. Shower drain doesn’t work properly and water leaks onto the bathroom floor making it a potential hazard. Despite repeated requests, the issues weren't addressed promptly. Hotel restaurant doesn't accommodate dietary restrictions well.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel

Downside_Review: There were no notable downsides worth mentioning.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel

It's also conveniently located, with close proximity to transport links and major attractions, making it easy to explore the city.
Downside_Review: Probably the only downside is the lack of a gym, but with all the attractions around, you'll have plenty of walking to keep you active.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The hotel has an interesting location, it's situated near shopping centers and restaurants which are a walking distance from the hotel.

Breakfast was not diverse enough and not up to expectation, this is not what I usually get from a Holiday Inn Express Hotel. The noise insulation was also pretty bad, we could hear people talking in the hallway and also the car noise from outside.

Downside_Review: The room was barely cleaned, the air conditioning was poor and the breakfast lacked variety

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel

Downside_Review: The staff was unprofessional and the hotel seemed outdated. Breakfast variety was ridiculous and the same food was served every day. Room cleanliness was also an issue. I would not recommend this hotel for stay in Beijing.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: Central location with easy access to public transportation.
Downside_Review: Rooms were outdated and poorly maintained with malfunctioning air conditioning. Housekeeping overlooked several areas during daily cleanings. Poor buffet breakfast selection and inconsistent replenishing. Staff were struggling with English which led to communication difficulties.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Dongzhimen, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: Centrally located with easy access to public transport
Downside_Review: The hotel has serious issues with hygiene, found stains on the bedsheets upon arrival. The room service was very slow, had to call multiple times to get towels. The breakfast was subpar with very limited variety. Also, the Wifi was incredibly slow and inconsistent which made it difficult to work or even browse.

Upside_Review: The Great Wall Hotel Beijing is perfectly situated, just a short taxi distance away from major attractions. The room was clean, spacious and offering a splendid view of the city. The buffet breakfast was extensive and truly impressive.
Downside_Review: While the hotel is great overall, communication in English was a bit tricky with some of the staff.

Upside_Review: The Great Wall Hotel Beijing exceeded all my expectations. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-appointed. The location is also fantastic, being just a stone's throw away from Beijing's major attractions. The staff was friendly, courteous, and went out of their way to ensure our stay was comfortable.
Downside_Review: It was a bit difficult to communicate with some of the staff due to language barriers, but it did not greatly impact our overall experience.

Upside_Review: The hotel is an excellent place to stay with clean, comfortable rooms and fantastic onsite amenities.
Downside_Review: The evening entertainment offerings could be improved.

Upside_Review: The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Beijing, in close proximity to major attractions and business districts. Rooms are spacious and tastefully decorated, with all the modern amenities that one could need. The staff was incredibly helpful and the service was top-notch. The on-site restaurants offer a variety of cuisines that cater to all taste buds. A very enjoyable stay!
Outstanding service, comfortable rooms, excellent location
Downside_Review: Limited variety of cuisines

Upside_Review: The view from the room was impressive and the location was close to the city center.
Downside_Review: The Great Wall Hotel Beijing was something of a disappointment. Although it's advertised as a luxury hotel, the room decor was outdated and tired. The carpets in the hallways were worn and unclean, and the elevator was sluggish. Furthermore, the staff's English proficiency was limited and it made communication challenging. The WiFi connection was poor and inconsistent. Additionally, the buffet breakfast was repetitive and lacked variety. Rooms were inadequately soundproofed; noise from surrounding rooms and the hallway was easily audible. Lastly, the bathrooms used outdated fixtures and there were constant issues with running hot water.

Upside_Review: The location of the hotel was advantageous and in the heart of Beijing, which was nice.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the air conditioning was not functioning properly which made my stay very uncomfortable. Moreover, the staff was not very helpful or accommodating. They seemed uninterested in providing excellent customer service which was disappointing. The meals at the hotel restaurant were overpriced and mediocre at best. Also, there was constant noise from other guests that the hotel management failed to address. Lastly, I found the WiFi to be extremely slow which hindered my ability to work and communicate with my friends and family back home. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

Upside_Review: The location of The Great Wall Hotel Beijing was decent and convenient for travel around Beijing.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, my stay at The Great Wall Hotel Beijing was less than satisfying on a few fronts. Firstly, the level of customer service was quite debatable, ranging from little to no assistance in the handling of basic requests. Secondly, the standard of the room left a lot to be desired, with worn out furnishings and a lack of thorough cleaning. Lastly, the in-house amenities such as the fitness center and dining options were subpar and not up to industry standards. The fitness center was poorly equipped and the dining options were limited and low quality.

Upside_Review: The hotel has spacious rooms and a great view of the city.
Downside_Review: Despite its impressive exterior and lobby, the rooms are outdated and not well-maintained. Also, some staff members are not adept at communicating in English, which made the stay quite challenging. Lastly, it's not as close to the city center as I would have liked.

Upside_Review: Convenient location and nice city views
Downside_Review: Very poor service. The staff didn't seem to care at all about their guests. The rooms were not clean and we were disappointed by the amenities provided. Overall, not a good value for money.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: I found Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven to be a very comfy and enjoyable place to stay. It's located not too far from the city centre, providing easy access to popular attractions and public transport. The room was clean, spacious and had a lovely view. The staff were welcoming and helpful, they truly made the stay pleasant. The breakfast buffet had a good choice of local as well as Western dishes, which was a delightful way to start each day.
Downside_Review: There were minor communication hiccups given the language barriers, but nothing too major that it affected my overall experience.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: Incredibly warm hospitality, rooms are spotless, larger than average breakfast selection.
Downside_Review: None

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The Holiday Inn Express in Beijing was top notch! Comfortable beds, clean and modern rooms, and the breakfast spread had a variety of Western and Chinese options. It was conveniently located to the Temple of Heaven and within easy access to public transportation.
Downside_Review: The only issue was the language barrier with some staff but they always tried their best to assist.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: Perfect location next to Temple of Heaven - a must-see in Beijing. The staff was really friendly and proficient in English, which made communication easy. The rooms were clean, spacious and well equipped.
Downside_Review: None

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: Great, attentive staff, well-kept rooms, fantastic location close to popular attractions and public transportation
Downside_Review: Limited dining options in the hotel, but many nearby

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The hotel is near Temple of Heaven, which is convenient for sightseeing.
Downside_Review: The room was quite dusty, and the cleaning is not done properly. The breakfast buffet is very limited and does not cater well to western tastes. The front desk staff seems a bit standoffish practically ignoring hotel guests. The wifi connection was also poor, making it difficult for me to plan my days and keep in touch with family back home.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The location is convenient and there are many food options nearby.
Downside_Review: The hotel rooms feel outdated and could use some improvements. The walls are thin so you can hear the conversations from the next room. The breakfast selection was very limited and the English proficiency of the staff was also lacking.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The lobby of the hotel was quite welcoming, and the location was quite close to the Temple of Heaven.
Downside_Review: The room felt quite outdated with worn out furniture. The air conditioning system was ineffective, making the room uncomfortably warm. Furthermore, most of the staff were not proficient in English, causing lots of communication issues. Not up to the usual standards I've come to expect from a Holiday Inn Express.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The location was somewhat close to the Temple of Heaven
Downside_Review: The room wasn't clean, the carpet was stained, and the staff was not very helpful or proficient in English. Additionally, the breakfast was disappointing for western standards with very limited choices.

Hotel Name: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Temple of Heaven, an IHG Hotel
Upside_Review: The hotel is quite near to the Temple of Heaven and within walking distance to subway stations. The room size is acceptable.
Downside_Review: The worst part was the food. The breakfast had very limited Western options. The taste was so-so with no daily variety. The cleaning service was not the best either, and the bathroom in the room was sometimes left uncleaned. My room was not replenished with toiletries regularly and the internet connection was slow.

Upside_Review: The ambiance is truly unique, transporting you back to ancient China the moment you step inside. The services provided were commendable, with attentiveness from the staff that makes the stay more comfortable. The rooms are clean, well-maintained, and keeps the authenticity of the traditional design while providing modern conveniences.
Downside_Review: While the location provides a deep immersion of the local culture, it may not be conveniently located for some popular tourist destinations. Some may find maneuvering around the narrow streets a bit confusing.

Upside_Review: I was in awe of the architecture and historical aura it had while still delivering modern amenities. The hotel is in the heart of Beijing, making it very convenient for sightseeing. The staff was exceptionally courteous and accommodative.
Quiet location just outside the hustle and bustle of the city center. Comfortable beds, friendly front of house staff, excellent breakfast buffet.
Downside_Review: Wifi was a bit spotty at times.

Upside_Review: SonGy Hundred-year Courtyard Hotel is an oasis of tranquility in the bustling city of Beijing.
