Downside_Review: The only downside was the lack of a fitness center, but Rome's spectacular sights more than made up for our exercise.

Upside_Review: The hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of many of Rome's attractions. The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. The room was spacious and well-appointed, with a comfortable bed and a clean, modern bathroom.
Downside_Review: No major complaints, but would be better if a kettle in the room was provided.

Upside_Review: Welcoming staff, good location, comfortable rooms.
Downside_Review: Nothing that I can think of

Upside_Review: The hotel is in a prime location, close to all major sights and the rooms are very comfortable. The staff is friendly and always ready to help.
Downside_Review: Breakfast selection could be improved. Having a few more options would be nice.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location close to some tourist attractions is commendable
Downside_Review: The hotel, Exe International Palace, doesn't live up to the expectations it sets with its grand name. The rooms are outdated, with peeling wallpaper and questionable cleanliness throughout. Requests for room service were met with long wait times and subpar food quality. The internet connection was frustratingly weak, making it impossible to conduct any necessary work or research. The noise levels were also unacceptable due to poor soundproofing and annoying road traffic. The staff lacked warmth and attentiveness, further detracting from the overall experience

Upside_Review: The location of Exe International Palace is superb, closely located to all tourist spots and the central station. The breakfast served was alright, but could use some variety.
Downside_Review: Rooms are quite dated with uncomfortable beds. The air-conditioning was not working properly and it made the room unbearably warm. The staff could have been more forthcoming with their assistance. I was also disappointed with the cleanliness in the room and the unavailability of basic amenities.

Upside_Review: The location was convenient, not far from the major sights.
Downside_Review: Most of the front desk staff were indifferent and not very helpful. The air conditioning was inconsistent thereby making the rooms hot and stuffy. Beds were too firm and uncomfortable, leading to sleepless nights. Breakfast had very limited options and were the same every day. Additionally, the walls are thin, so you can hear the people in the adjacent room. Definitely does not live up to being a 4-star hotel.

Upside_Review: Centrally located for sightseeing purposes
Downside_Review: Rooms were outdated and the air conditioning wasn't very effective. Wi-Fi was patchy and kept disconnecting. Service was not up to standard and it felt like the staff was not very attentive or responsive to our needs.

Upside_Review: Good location, close to many attractions
Downside_Review: Rooms were not well-maintained, furniture was old and out-dated, and customer service was not up to standard. Breakfast was average at best.

Upside_Review: Excellent service: helpful and professional staff. The room was clean, spacious and well equipped. The place is so quiet that I didn't even realize I was in Rome. Plus, they provide a shuttle bus to Vatican city which is a great service.
Downside_Review: The breakfast could be a bit more diverse, but overall it was good

Upside_Review: The room was spacious and clean, and staff were very welcoming. The location was peaceful and offered a respite from the bustling city.
Downside_Review: The shuttle service times could be more flexible.

Upside_Review: The peacefulness of the hotel and the room comfort particularly caught my attention. The hotel is in a quiet area surrounded by nature, away from the hustle and bustle of the city center. It's an excellent choice for travelers looking for peace and relaxation. The rooms are modern and spacious and provide a beautiful view over the park. The pool area is enjoyable and well-maintained. The hotel staff was incredibly courteous and went out of their way to assist us through our stay.
Downside_Review: The location is a bit far from the city center and there isn't much to do around the immediate vicinity of the hotel. You need to take a bus to get to the nearest metro station. This makes the hotel less ideal for those who wish to be within walking distance of the major points of interest.

Upside_Review: The Hotel Villa Pamphili Roma was absolutely delightful, the rooms were spacious and beautifully decorated. In-room amenities were plentiful, including high-quality toiletries and a fully stocked minibar. The hotel's location is indeed a highlight, conveniently situated near major attractions, yet offers a serene retreat with its magnificent garden views.
Downside_Review: Some guests might find the traditional decor a little dated, but otherwise, there's little to fault.

Upside_Review: Villa Pamphili provided a serene retreat away from Rome's hustle and bustle, boasting beautiful grounds and comfortable rooms. The breakfast was delicious and the staff was extremely polite and helpful.
Downside_Review: The hotel is a bit far away from the city center but the shuttles provided by the hotel were very convenient and punctual.

Upside_Review: Hotel grounds are green, peaceful, and tranquil. The pool is definitely a plus.
Downside_Review: Regrettably, the rooms were dated and not really clean. The bathroom needs renovating, and the towels were rough and old. Wifi was slow and often disconnected. The breakfast was disappointing for the price we paid too.

Upside_Review: The hotel's serene environment
Downside_Review: The hotel is rather far from the city centre, and the shuttle service is not consistent. Rooms are quite outdated with malfunctioning air conditioning. The staff did not seem very accommodating, and the quality of the food in the restaurant was underwhelming. Also, the pool was not well-maintained and the Wi-Fi connection was very poor throughout my stay.

Upside_Review: nice view from the room
Downside_Review: Room is uncleaned and staff are uncooperative. Air conditioning system is too loud and couldn't sleep properly.

Upside_Review: The hotel garden and outdoor spaces are beautiful. The shuttle bus service is also a nice touch, helping to make the city centre more accessible.
Downside_Review: However, the rooms are outdated and lacking basic amenities. The shower had little pressure and the AC was excessively noisy. Room service menu was rather limited too. The staff on the reception could slightly improve their communication skills as well. Transit to the city without the shuttle service is a bit inconvenient.

Upside_Review: The scenery around the Hotel Villa Pamphili Roma is quite picturesque. The pool area is a real asset and the staff members there were gracious.
Downside_Review: However, the rooms feel dated and could do with a revamp. Also, the shuttle service to the city center is unreliable and infrequent making it a hassle to commute. The room service menu lacks variety and the food was uninspiring.

Upside_Review: From its impeccable location in central Myeongdong to its comfortable rooms and diligent staff, the Hotel Skypark Central Myeongdong made my stay in Seoul an absolute delight. The hotel's proximity to shopping and dining options was an added advantage.
Downside_Review: While they could use a bit more variety in their breakfast menu, it didn't detract much from the overall excellent experience.

Upside_Review: Perfect location for shopping, nice view
Downside_Review: Breakfast could have more variety

Upside_Review: The location was great. Staff were friendly and breakfast was good
Downside_Review: Had to carry luggage up and down the stairs

Upside_Review: Fantastic location right in the heart of Myeongdong, surrounded by shopping and food. Room was clean and comfortable, staff were friendly and helpful. Appreciated the free shuttle to tourist attractions.
Amazing location, smack dab in the middle of Myeong-dong. Convenient for shopping and exploring Seoul. Clean and comfortable rooms with free water
Downside_Review: The only downside is the lack of variety in breakfast. However, the location itself has plenty of food options.

Upside_Review: The location of Hotel Skypark Central Myeongdong in Seoul is conveniently close to many restaurants and shopping districts.
Downside_Review: However, the room cleanliness was not up to par, with dust found in corners and a sense of general disarray. Service was also lacking, often with long waits for assistance and room service items sometimes not arriving. Also, the noise from the streets late at night made it difficult to get a good night's sleep. It didn't live up to my expectations.

Upside_Review: The location is fantastic, in the middle of Myeongdong, close to shopping and food areas.
Downside_Review: Rooms are rather small, little natural light inside the room makes it feel cramped. The room also had a strong cigarette smell when we checked in, even though it's supposed to be a non-smoking room. Also, the walls are thin - you can hear people talking in the hallway.

Upside_Review: The location is very convenient, right in the heart of Myeongdong. The staff are friendly and try to be as helpful as possible.
Downside_Review: The rooms are quite small and not as clean as I would expect from a hotel of this standard. Also, the breakfast left much to be desired, not much variety and the food quality was mediocre.

Upside_Review: Location is quite perfect, close to every facilities and attractions.
Downside_Review: The hotel staff were not helpful at all. When I had a problem with my room, I reported it to the front desk but no action was taken. The room was not clean, the towels were old and worn out. The noise from the street was also a major problem. I could barely sleep at night. The breakfast was also not worth the price. Overall, I do not recommend this hotel to other tourists looking for a pleasant stay in Seoul.

Upside_Review: Centrally located
Downside_Review: I was extremely disappointed with the accommodation itself. The room was small, dark, and did not look clean. The furniture was old and worn out, and the Bathroom was outdated and not clean either. The air conditioner did not work properly which made our stay uncomfortable. This is certainly not the standard I was expecting when booking with Hotel Skypark Central Myeongdong.

Upside_Review: Centrally located in Itaewon, the Hamilton Hotel is a bustling hub of activity and an ideal landing spot for first-time visitors to Seoul. The proximity to the subway station and the bevy of local restaurants and shops make exploring the city easy and convenient. The rooftop pool offers a phenomenal vista of the city sky-line, providing relaxation amidst the city rush. Moreover, the cleanliness and modern amenities within the rooms themselves offers a comfortable abode after a day spent out exploring.
Downside_Review: The hotel can feel busy at times due to its popularity. However, staff always handle the influx of guests proficiently.

Upside_Review: Excellent location, cozy rooms and skilled staff. The hotel is located close to some popular tourist attractions and restaurants. Convenient in-house currency exchange service.
Downside_Review: Room view wasn't spectacular but interior is nice.

Upside_Review: Hamilton Hotel was a delight to stay at. The location was convenient with subway stations, shopping streets, and food markets within short walking distance. The staff was professional and courteous. Our room was well maintained, clean, and the bed was exceptionally comfortable. The amenities were also top notch. The hotel also had a swimming pool which became a relaxing spot after a day of sightseeing. The dining options were abundant around the hotel and we also liked the in-house restaurant.
Downside_Review: The only downside was that our room faced the street so it was a bit noisy at times, maybe rooms away from the street could solve this minor issue.

Upside_Review: The Hamilton Hotel in Seoul offers comfortable accommodations, swift room service, and an alluring sense of Seoul's rich culture. Its central location provides easy access to local attractions, and I particularly enjoyed the diverse options for dining. Staff were invariably courteous and helpful, and all the utilities were top-notch.
Downside_Review: However, the noise from the surrounding area may be a bit distracting for some, especially if your room is located towards the street side. Others may find the hotel's bustling location quite charming.

Upside_Review: Hamilton Hotel is a gem located in Seoul. From our check-in to check-out, everything was handled with ease. The staff were not only professional but extremely courteous as well. They took care of all our needs, and were always smiling. The rooms were well equipped with modern amenities and were kept immaculately clean. They were spacious and provided us with a serene retreat after a busy day exploring the city. The breakfast was simply delicious, offering a diverse range of local and international cuisines. The hotel's location was another significant advantage. It was a short walk to restaurants, bars, and shopping areas. Overall, a great hotel experience and certainly one I'll recommend to others.
Downside_Review: No significant downsides to mention. It would be beneficial though if they could provide more variety in their breakfast menu.

Upside_Review: The hotel is around lots of good restaurants and a subway station.
Downside_Review: The room was not cleaned well. There were old toiletries left in the bathroom from previous guests. The water pressure in the shower was very low and the temperature was inconsistent. The carpets and furniture are quite dated.

Upside_Review: The location was quite convenient
Downside_Review: The room was not well-cleaned when I checked in, and the amenities were not replenished during my stay

Upside_Review: The location is good as it is right beside the subway exit.
Downside_Review: The hotel seems old and is in need of renovation. The carpet in the room was worn-out and stained. The walls were marked and the bathroom was grimy with a broken toilet seat. The lobby was chaotic with people and suitcases everywhere. The staff were curt and not approachable. The rooms had thin walls, I could hear guest conversations and their television. Quite unpleasant for light sleepers. Would not recommend for those seeking a comfortable and relaxing experience.

Upside_Review: The hotel is centrally located and near the subway station.
Downside_Review: This hotel is outdated and needs renovation urgently. The customer service was subpar and the staff was not really attentive. The noise from the street made it difficult to get a good night's sleep. Additionally, the Wi-Fi connection was very unstable.

Upside_Review: The location of Hamilton Hotel is superb, right in the heart of Itaewon.
Downside_Review: However, the rooms are small and could use an update. The noise from the outside was quite loud and the soundproofing was not great. The staff were relatively indifferent and not particularly helpful.

Upside_Review: Great location, spacious rooms and excellent staff. The kitchen facilities were a plus point too!
Downside_Review: A little overhaul in the rooms could make the hotel even better, but it's still pretty good!

Upside_Review: The Orakai Insadong Suites in Seoul were a delight to stay at. I was impressed by the suite's spaciousness and cleanliness. The high-tech appliances and elegant furniture created a luxurious setting for my stay. The staff was also notably attentive and accommodating. The location was another perk as there were many restaurants and shops nearby.
Downside_Review: The only downside was that the internet connection was somewhat inconsistent, but this was a minor inconvenience compared to the overall fantastic experience.

Upside_Review: The suite was spacious, spotlessly clean, and well-equipped. The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. The location in Insadong was perfect, with great restaurants and shops nearby.
Downside_Review: There were no substantial issues worth mentioning.

Upside_Review: Centrally located, room was spacious and beds comfortable. Staff was friendly and service-oriented. The view from the room was breathtaking.
Downside_Review: There could have been a few more dining options.

Upside_Review: Orakai Insadong Suites provides a true home away from home experience. The location is excellent with lots of places to eat right outside the door. The staff is extremely friendly and always ready to assist with any inquiries. The suites themselves are well-equipped and beautifully furnished, providing a comfortable place to return to after a busy day exploring Seoul.
Downside_Review: The downside only would be having to leave the hotel at the end of our stay.

Upside_Review: The rooms were spacious
Downside_Review: the cleanliness left a lot to be desired, and the staff was not very helpful

Upside_Review: Spacious room layout
Downside_Review: The staff were not accommodating and unprofessional. The room cleanliness fell short, seeing dust on the bedside tables.

Upside_Review: Hotel's location in the heart of Insadong
Downside_Review: The rooms were unnecessarily big with tons of wasted of space, furniture and appliances were outdated, the Wifi was unreliable, and hotel staff were largely uninterested in assisting with any concerns.

Upside_Review: The location in Insadong is excellent and the apartment space is generous.
Downside_Review: The facilities are very dated and require an overhaul, the carpet in the room was stained, the bedspread had a tear in it and the walls had marks on them. Despite calls to management and promises of getting things fixed, nothing was done. Disappointing quality, service and overpriced considering the condition of the apartment.

Upside_Review: The location of the Orakai Insadong Suites in Seoul was pretty convenient and central to most attractions in the city.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, my overall stay at the Orakai Insadong Suites in Seoul was quite underwhelming and disappointing. Firstly, the rooms were quite outdated and needed urgent modernization. The furniture and equipment seemed old, making the room feel dull and uninviting. Secondly, the cleanliness of the rooms was not up to par. I found dust on the furniture and the bathroom needed a good deep cleaning. Lastly, the services provided by the staff were poor. The staff seemed unprofessional and lacked adequate training. They were not able to provide prompt and efficient service, making my stay even less pleasant.

Upside_Review: Modern interior and friendly service
Downside_Review: Nothing to mention

Upside_Review: Efficient service, perfectly located, and offers a spacious, comfortable room with modern amenities. The concierge was always ready to assist with excellent restaurant recommendations and reservation assistance. There is also a wonderful bakery on the ground floor that shouldn't be missed.
Downside_Review: Some of the bath towels were slightly worn out and could be replaced.

Upside_Review: Hotel decor was modern and unique, rooms were impeccably clean and comfortable, and the staff were excellent - very helpful and friendly. Also, the location is fantastic, lots of restaurants and shops nearby.
Downside_Review: The lighting in the bathroom could have been brighter and the breakfast selection could be a bit more extensive, but these are just small details.

Upside_Review: Stylish, comfortable rooms with excellent customer service
Downside_Review: Minor issue with slow elevator service.

Upside_Review: Loved the contemporary design, the lively neighbourhood and the helpful hotel staff
Downside_Review: The walls are a bit thin, which can be a problem if you have noisy neighbours

Upside_Review: The location of the hotel was great, easy access to various hotspots in Seoul.
Downside_Review: Hotel staff was often unresponsive and not highly proficient in English which made communication difficult. Additionally, the rooms were not thoroughly cleaned and lacked maintenance.

Upside_Review: The hotel has a modern design and it's located in a trendy area with many dining options around. Close to a metro station which makes it easy to explore the city.
Downside_Review: The room was smaller than expected. Hotel staff was not as helpful as they could have been. Noise from the street and other rooms was quite disruptive during the night.

Upside_Review: Location was very good, in the heart of Itaewon and close to the metro station. Also, the room designs were artistic and unique.
Downside_Review: The hotel room was not cleaned properly upon arrival, particularly the bathroom had a strong unpleasant smell. Also, the pillows were too flat and the mattress was uncomfortable, resulting in a sleepless night. Customer service was lacking as well, staff were not willing to address these issues when confronted.

Upside_Review: The hotel is centrally located, with restaurants, transportation options, and attractions close by. The design of the lobby is modern and attractive, and the rooms seemed well-maintained initially.
Downside_Review: Despite the positives, the negatives outweighed them. The noise level was intolerable, with loud chatter and music reverberating through the hallways until the early hours.  Furthermore, the customer service was lacking. The front desk staff were non-responsive and seemingly disinterested in providing help or addressing issues. I also wasn't satisfied with the cleanliness of the room. Upon closer inspection, there appeared to be stains on the carpet and dust in several places. For the price that I paid, the experience fell short of expectations.

Upside_Review: The location in the heart of Itaewon was convenient for restaurants and shopping.
Downside_Review: Rooms were quite small and I experienced some issues with cleanliness. Staff were not very helpful with resolution.

Upside_Review: Beautiful hotel with a fantastic location near shopping and food areas. The room was modern, beautiful and clean. It was quiet and I slept very well. Staff were really helpful and kind. Breakfast was fantastic. The transport links were great as it was near a subway station.
Downside_Review: Really, nothing to complain about. Perhaps, the rooms are a bit small.

Upside_Review: Well-located, and room with a wonderful view! Breakfast was delicious
Excellent location with stunning view. Room was very comfortable and service was top-notch

Exceptional hotel. Perfect location. Professional, courteous and friendly staff. Clean room with fully stocked amenities. The view from the room was beautiful and breath-taking! The breakfast buffet was delicious and had a big variety of different foods. This hotel will be my first choice of stay whenever I visit Seoul again.
Downside_Review: Nothing to mention, everything was perfect.

Upside_Review: LOTTE City Hotel Myeongdong is truly a gem in the heart of Seoul. The rooms are modern, clean, and well-equipped with amenities. The location is remarkable, offering easy access to stores, restaurants, and local attractions. The staff is wonderfully polite and always ready to assist with a smile.
Downside_Review: The hotel was quite busy during my visit, so it might not be the best choice for travelers seeking a quiet stay. Also, the breakfast could offer more vegetarian options.

Upside_Review: The location was convenient, close to major shopping areas
Downside_Review: Room cleanliness did not meet our expectations and the hotel lacked basic amenities. The customer service was also unsatisfactory

Upside_Review: Good location
Downside_Review: Small rooms, language barrier with the staff, long check-in times, unappealing food at the restaurant

Upside_Review: ['Strategic location']
Downside_Review: The interior of the rooms is rather dated and could use a facelift. In addition, some of the staff at the front desk were quite unfriendly and unresponsive to our queries, which was off-putting.

Upside_Review: The location of the hotel is convenient, being situated near Lotte Department Store and Myeongdong Shopping Street. The views from the hotel rooms are also fairly nice.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, my experience at the LOTTE City Hotel Myeongdong was far from ideal. My room was not well-cleaned when I checked in, with visible dust and stains on the furniture. Furthermore, there was a constant noise coming from the ventilation system which made it difficult for me to sleep well. Customer service was also sorely lacking, the staff was not attentive to guest needs and requests were not handled promptly. The breakfast buffet was very lackluster with a limited variety of options and often out of common items. Regrettably, the quality of the hotel did not match its price.

Upside_Review: Fantastic view of the city from room.
Downside_Review: The room was smaller than expected and could do with a deep cleaning. The breakfast buffet was lackluster with limited options. The staff, although polite, didn't seem very knowledgeable about the surrounding area when asked for recommendations.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: The Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station offered a truly delightful stay during my visit to Seoul. Its strategic location, close to Seoul train station, made it supremely convenient for my travels within the city. The hotel staff were professional, warm, and ever helpful – adding a true sense of comfort to my stay. The rooms are well-appointed, super clean, and comfortable, and the breakfast spread was complimentary, offering a vast variety of sumptuous dishes.
Downside_Review: This hotel is saying all the right things, but it could have been even better with a swimming pool, which unfortunately it doesn't have.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: The hotel is well-located and close to the Seoul Station. The room sizes are very generous and the bed extremely comfortable. The staff are professional and welcoming.
Downside_Review: The breakfast buffet is quite expensive for the variety it offers.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station provided an outstanding stay. The rooms were spotless, the service was first-rate, and the hotel's proximity to Seoul's lively city center was perfect. Additionally, the spectacular city views, comfortable beds, and delectable dining options contributed to an overall enjoyable experience.
Downside_Review: Nothing worth mentioning, it was a great stay all round.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: A nice and comfortable stay. Proximity to Seoul station made traveling easier.
Downside_Review: None

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: Delicious breakfast options and very close proximity to Seoul station.
Downside_Review: It would have been nice to have a few more English TV channels.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: The location is convenient being close to Seoul Station. It is also walking distance from Namdaemun market and the Lotte Outlet.
Downside_Review: The room itself lacked the standard cleanliness I've come to expect from a Four Points hotel. The carpet was dirty and gave off an unpleasant odor. The bathroom fixtures were outdated and in desperate need of an upgrade or at the very least, a proper cleaning and maintenance. The staff, while not rude, were not warm or welcoming either. Breakfast service was subpar with a lack of variety and poorly prepared meals. Noise from the nearby roads and train station also made it difficult to get a peaceful night's sleep. There was also a lack of English speaking staff which can be a problem for international guests.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: The hotel's location is excellent, within easy walking distance to the Seoul station and shopping areas. The lobby and public areas are sharply decorated and clean
Downside_Review: We found that the rooms were not cleaned well, the linens were unappealing, and there was insufficient light in the room making it very gloomy. Furthermore, basic necessities like toiletries were not stocked well and had to be requested multiple times. The breakfast spread was quite limited and the taste was an utter disappointment.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: Convenient location next to Seoul station
Downside_Review: Room was a little small and a bit outdated, bed wasn't very comfortable, and the Wi-Fi was intermittent at best. Also, the service at the restaurant was very slow and the food was quite mediocre.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: Location is relatively central, room is clean and they provide refrigerator and safe in the room which is a plus point. The staff at the front desk was friendly and efficient during check-in and check-out.
Downside_Review: The rooms are rather small and the walls were thin which makes it hard to get a good night's sleep since you can hear your neighbor's chatter and TV sound. The breakfast was identical every morning with very limited variation which got very boring soon. Addition to this, the hotel service was underwhelming with some of the staff being unresponsive to requests.

Hotel Name: Four Points by Sheraton Josun, Seoul Station
Upside_Review: The staffs were generally friendly and responsive.
Downside_Review: The hotel rooms were in dire need of refurbishment. The furniture was old and the carpets damp, giving the room a musty smell. Even though it was a non-smoking room, I found cigarette burns on the carpet. Heating system was very inconsistent, blowing cold air even when we asked for warm. The breakfast buffet was quite disappointing with limited choices for the price. To make matters worse, the view from my room was towards an old building, quite a let down considering their prime location. I expected more from a Four Points by Sheraton.

Upside_Review: Exceptional staff and service
Downside_Review: Nothing

Upside_Review: I have nothing but good words for Stay Hotel Gangnam. The location is fantastic, with easy access to shopping, restaurants, and public transportation. The staff is courteous, attentive, and always willing to assist. Our room was clean, comfortable, and spacious.
Downside_Review: The only downside perhaps is the limited variety in their breakfast options but it's a small concern compared to the grand scale of positives.

Upside_Review: I must admit that Stay Hotel Gangnam in Seoul is a fantastic hotel. It's one of the most convenient hotels in the city, easily accessible from many iconic tourist spots. The staff were professional and extremely helpful, always ready to settle any issues with a smile. The rooms were well designed, clean and comfortable, offering a wonderful panoramic view of the city. Last but not the least, the breakfast - it was extensive and appetizing, and had something to cater to everyone's taste.
Downside_Review: The hotel has a slightly difficult initial access for the first time visitors due to its location on an uphill. You might need to use a map or take a taxi if you're not familiar with Seoul.

Upside_Review: The property is ideally situated for easy access to all attractions. The room was spacious and clean with a comfortable bed. The staff were friendly and helpful.
Downside_Review: The selection of the breakfast could have been better.

Upside_Review: Convenient location and clean, modern rooms. The staff's customer service was top-notch.
Downside_Review: The breakfast selection could be improved with more international choices.

Upside_Review: The location of the Stay Hotel Gangnam is its only redeeming quality. It's nearby to several restaurants, shops, and the subway station.
Downside_Review: I had a very disappointing stay at the Stay Hotel Gangnam. The room was small, the bed uncomfortable, and the bathroom was in need of serious refurbishing. The staff seemed uninterested and lacked the helpfulness one usually expects from hotel personnel. While the hotel rooms were technically clean, they felt run-down and not particularly well-maintained. The furnishings and decor were outdated and the room lacked basic, expected amenities. There was a lingering odor of smoke throughout my entire stay, further worsening the experience. Because of these extensive issues, I wouldn't recommend the Stay Hotel Gangnam to anyone.

Upside_Review: Convenient location
Downside_Review: Rooms are small and did not feel clean. Air conditioning was unreliable, turning off in the middle of the night making it impossible to sleep. The staff was not very helpful and had difficult times understanding and speaking English. The breakfast was limited.

Upside_Review: Great location
Downside_Review: The hotel is old and the rooms need renovation. The air conditioning is loud and not functioning properly. Service could be improved.

Upside_Review: The location is convenient and the staffs are generally friendly and helpful
Downside_Review: The rooms were relatively small and mildly uncomfortable. The supposed high-speed internet wasn't as speedy as I expected, and the overall cleanliness of the amenities left a lot to be desired. Moreover, noise pollution from the surrounding area could get unbearable at times

Upside_Review: The location of Stay Hotel Gangnam in Seoul is absolutely spot-on. It is conveniently close to shopping malls and restaurants.
Downside_Review: Nevertheless, the overall experience was below par. The rooms were quite small and not very clean. Customer service was also quite mediocre as the staff seemed to be not well-trained and unresponsive to requests. Furthermore, the WiFi in the room was pretty unstable, causing inconvenience.

Upside_Review: The hotel is very conveniently located in Myeongdong and is a mere minute's walk to a convenience store, a couple of minutes to the bustling shopping markets, and a 5 minute walk to the subway. The staff was very professional and warm, and their English service was commendable. The complimentary breakfast was filling and varied daily
Downside_Review: WiFi in my room was rather weak at times

Upside_Review: Fantastic location with many shops nearby, the hotel restaurant offers good food. Rooms are clean and well equipped.
Downside_Review: The pillows and mattresses could be softer as they were slightly uncomfortable.

Upside_Review: The location of Ibis Styles Ambassador Seoul Myeong-dong was ideal. It's a quick walk to the subway lines, great shopping, and delectable street food. Moreover, stunning city views from the roof and clean, modern room layout provide an incredible experience all around.
Downside_Review: The breakfast generally lacked variety but tasted decent, and the lobby was a bit crowded at peak times.

Upside_Review: The view from the rooftop bar is stunning, especially at night when the city is all lit up. Staff are helpful and attentive, always ready to assist. It's clean, room service was quick and the food was tasty.
Downside_Review: The elevator is quite slow, and during peak hours, there might be a bit of a wait.

Upside_Review: Situated in the heart of the city, this hotel provides easy access to all major tourist attractions. Rooms were clean and cozy. The staff were very accommodating and provided excellent service.
Downside_Review: Breakfast was somewhat lacking in variety, but satisfactory overall

Upside_Review: centrally located near shopping districts
Downside_Review: the rooms are small, ill-ventilated and the beddings were not properly cleaned

Upside_Review: Good location, close to shopping area
Downside_Review: The room was quite small, not much space for luggage. The bed was too firm, ended up waking up with a backache. The staff didn't seem very enthusiastic in assisting us

Though the location was great, it was the only redeeming factor of my stay. The cleanliness left a lot to be desired and I found several hairs in the bathroom. The soundproofing was not good, and I could hear the noise from the hallway and the next room. The staff also seemed curt and not very helpful. Altogether, it was a disappointing experience at Ibis Styles Ambassador Seoul Myeong-dong.

Upside_Review: The hotel has a great location, right in the heart of the city. The room had a nice view of the city too.
Downside_Review: It was disappointing that the heating in the room was stuck on at about 25 degrees Celsius and the solution from staff was to open a window, which in a city as populated as Seoul is far from perfect. The drain in the shower was also far from perfect, I ended up standing in my own dirty water every time. Breakfast was ok, but the food was often cool, even early in the morning, and the same food was served every day. The WiFi was also severely lacking in the rooms.

Upside_Review: Location is good, near to Myeongdong shopping district.
Downside_Review: The room is too small and not enough space for luggage. The soundproofing is bad, can hear noise from the hallway and the nearby rooms. Also, the breakfast lacks variety and it’s the same every day.

Upside_Review: The location was excellent, situated right in the heart of Dongdaemun shopping district. The rooms were clean and well-kept, and the staff were very friendly and helpful.
Located near many shopping outlets. Comfortable rooms and friendly staff. Breakfast was tasty and had a variety of options.
Downside_Review: The fitness center could do with a little upgrade.

Upside_Review: Great location, close to attractions and good roads. Very clean hotel and helpful staff.
Downside_Review: The room was a little small but perfect for our purposes.

Upside_Review: I was pleased by the room layout and cleanliness. It was relatively near to popular Seoul landmarks, which made my sightseeing explorations much easier.
Downside_Review: The breakfast variety could use some improvement, but it wasn't a deal breaker.

Upside_Review: Conveniently located near Dongdaemun Design Plaza, this hotel offers a comfortable place to stay after a day of sightseeing. The staff are friendly and accommodating, making sure your needs are attended to.
Downside_Review: The only minor issue was the limited selection for breakfast, which could be improved for a diverse clientele.

Upside_Review: Good location
Downside_Review: Room was very cold, heating was not working properly. The breakfast was very basic, not much to choose from. Beds were uncomfortable.

Upside_Review: The location is in close proximity to numerous shopping malls.
Downside_Review: The hotel room and bathrooms were much smaller than what I was led to believe. Additionally, some of the staff members were not exactly welcoming or particularly friendly. The room walls were quite thin, allowing noise from adjacent rooms to filter through easily. The breakfast selection could also be improved and diversified.

Upside_Review: The location was quite convenient.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the room was in an unsatisfactory state with unresponsive staff and inconsistent room service.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location is ideal, situated around the shopping area of Dongdaemun and near the subway for convenient movement.
Downside_Review: However, the hotel's service was significantly lacking. The check-in process was delayed and inefficient, and the restaurant and dining options were underwhelming. The room was also less comfortable than expected, with old and worn-out furniture, insufficient lighting, and inconsistency when it came to room service and cleaning. Furthermore, the communication barrier with the staff often resulted in misunderstandings, adding to the overall frustration.

Upside_Review: Convenient location with easy access to public transport
Downside_Review: The room was quite small and lacked needed amenities. Also, the noise from the street was disruptive during night.

Upside_Review: This central location is amazing! We walked to all the major landmarks and the surrounding area has countless good restaurants. The hotel itself is clean, well-maintained, and the service is excellent. Fast WiFi, comfortable bed, and a highly efficient housekeeping team contributed to making the stay comfortable and memorable.
Downside_Review: Not much to fault, only the room was a bit smaller than expected. But otherwise, everything else was perfect.

Upside_Review: The hotel was in an impeccable location, right in the heart of Myeongdong. The room was clean, cozy and well-equipped, and the staff were very courteous and helpful. The daily housekeeping was also a nice touch.
Downside_Review: There's really nothing to fault.

Upside_Review: Indeed, the Hotel Skypark Myeongdong 1 in Seoul has surpassed my expectations. The hotel was conveniently near public transport, meaning exploring Seoul was effortless. Friendly and accommodating staff further added to my excellent experience. Additionally, the rooms were clean and comfortable, ensuring a restful night’s sleep after a long day of tours.
Downside_Review: Cannot recall anything that disappointed me.

Upside_Review: Hotel Skypark Myeongdong 1 in Seoul offered a cozy and comfortable stay. Located in the heart of the city, it provided easy access to major shopping areas, restaurants, and attractions. The rooms were clean and well-maintained. The staff was amiable, efficient, and extremely helpful; their customer service was top-notch.
Downside_Review: Nothing major, just a slight difficulty in finding English language channels on TV.

Upside_Review: Location of Hotel Skypark Myeongdong 1 was perfect for my needs, right in the heart of Seoul. The rooms were clean, spacious and had a wonderful view of the city. The staff were very helpful and courteous throughout the duration my stay.
Downside_Review: Everything was great, there was nothing I disliked during my stay.

Upside_Review: The hotel's location is excellent, right in the bustling heart of Myeongdong.
Downside_Review: Felt very shabby and dated. The photos are not representative of the actual condition of the rooms. The room smelled musty and the mattress was uncomfortably hard. The AC did not work properly and the Wi-Fi signal was spotty at best. Toiletries were not replenished regularly and housekeeping felt very rushed and superficial. Lack of customer focus was keenly felt and we were rudely treated by most of the staff. Breakfast selection was poor and the food was unappetising. Left a lot to be desired for a hotel of this price point.

Upside_Review: Convenient location, good breakfast
Downside_Review: Small rooms, lacking amenities, and the service left much to be desired

Upside_Review: The location of the Hotel Skypark Myeongdong 1 is unbeatable. Right in the center of the buzzing Myeongdong area, it provides easy access to public transportation and various shopping and dining outlets.
Downside_Review: However, the room was quite small and cramped. The cleanliness was an issue and the hotel could use a significant update in terms of facilities and decor. An unexpected annoyance was the constant noise of street vendors and shoppers since it's located in a busy neighborhood. The staff could also do with some customer service training. Our concerns weren't addressed promptly which left us feeling rather neglected during our stay.

Upside_Review: The location was great, right in the heart of Myeongdong. Close to shopping and the subway. The rooftop view was a nice touch.
Downside_Review: The rooms are small and outdated. The WiFi was unreliable at best. The breakfast buffet wasn't worth the cost and the selection was disappointing.

Upside_Review: The hotel location is undoubtedly stellar, being situated in the heart of Myeongdong. It offers easy access to the shopping streets and variety of eateries.
Downside_Review: Sadly, my stay was marred by several issues. The room was noticeably small and felt cramped with hardly any space for luggage. Additionally, the in-room amenities were quite outdated and the Internet connection was abysmally slow, making any form of online work or entertainment nearly impossible. Lastly, while the staff was generally courteous, they seemed overwhelmed by the number of guests, leading to delay in services.

Upside_Review: Found the Generator Hotel to be a gem in the heart of Washington DC. The location alone is exceptional, with plenty of sights and restaurants within walking distance. The hotel staff went above and beyond to offer friendly and efficient service. Our room was clean, comfortable and surprisingly quiet for a city hotel. The in-house restaurant served a variety of delicious options which made meal times something to look forward to.
Downside_Review: The only downside was the somewhat expensive parking, but this is more a reflection of the area than the hotel itself.

Upside_Review: Well-designed, modern, and close to the most touristic attractions. Staff is friendly.
Downside_Review: The price of food and drinks at the hotel was a bit expensive.

Upside_Review: Nice location, friendly staff, very clean and comfortable! Excellent value for money.
Downside_Review: Limited food menu for in-room dining.

Upside_Review: The Generator Hotel in Washington DC provided an exceptional stay. With its modern amenities, helpful staff, and convenient location, it was the perfect spot for my trip. The rooms were clean, comfortable and quiet - a great respite from the busy city streets.
Comfortable beds, friendly staff, and a convenient location close to Metro.
Downside_Review: Can get a bit noisy during the evening with the bar downstairs, but nothing too extreme.

Upside_Review: The location is pretty much the only good thing about this hotel.
Downside_Review: The rooms are very small and uncomfortable, the amenities are lacking, and the service is quite poor. The noise from the street is extremely loud and the cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired. I would not recommend this hotel to other tourists.

Upside_Review: The hotel is near a metro station, which provides easy access to explore the city.
Downside_Review: The Generator Hotel was a total disappointment. The noise levels were intolerable - thanks to a lack of proper soundproofing; it felt like the traffic was in our room. The room was not as clean as I expected, with dust visible on furniture. The staff seemed disinterested and failed to provide necessary assistance during our stay. The hotel claims to be value for money but the services offered were not up to the mark, thus challenging this claim. I find it tough to recommend this hotel to fellow tourists.

Upside_Review: nice lobby and common area
Downside_Review: poor cleanliness, lack of customer service, small rooms, uncomfortable beds, loud noises

Upside_Review: Located quite centrally, a short walk from all the popular monuments and museums. The bar area downstairs was comfortable and a nice gathering place.
Downside_Review: The room was extremely small and cramped. The air conditioning was either freezing or suffocating, no middle ground. Breakfast not included and the option available was overpriced and not tasty. The Wi-Fi was incredibly slow and kept disconnecting. No room service.

Upside_Review: The hotel has a modern design, which can be appealing to younger guests. It's also in a convenient location.
Downside_Review: However, I found the lack of facilities quite disappointing. The noise from nearby train stations and even the corridors was virtually constant and sleep disrupting. The room was also a little small for comfort, and the bathroom facilities could use a bit of an update with poor water pressure and inconsistent hot water supply. The wi-fi was a bit spotty, which is a drawback if you're traveling for work.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center is an absolute gem of a hotel. The location was unbeatable, making the heart of the city easily accessible. The rooms were well furnished, comfortable, and impeccably clean. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and always available for help or recommendations.
Downside_Review: The only minor inconvenience during my stay was the limited options for food in their in-house restaurant. However, the location compensated for that with many amazing eateries just around the corner.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center was a fantastic place to stay. The location was optimal, providing easy access to a myriad of landmarks and attractions. The rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable. They featured modern decor and amenities that made my stay enjoyable. The staff was extremely courteous and helpful, ensuring that all my needs were catered for. The on-site dining options were also quite impressive, offering a diverse menu for all types of palette.
Downside_Review: I honestly could not find any downside to this hotel.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The city center location is fantastic for a short stay in Washington DC. Clean, contemporary rooms. Excellent service with friendly and reliable staff. The restaurants in and around the hotel provided a great variety of choices.
Downside_Review: There was a slight noise that could be heard from traffic outside. More insulation could be considered to limit noise.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: Stylish and modern design coupled with attentive staff enhanced my stay at the Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center. Conveniently located in a lively area, surrounded by numerous eateries catering for all tastes.
Downside_Review: Cannot fault anything about this place.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: Exceptional service and highly professional staff. Room was neat and well-equipped. Proximity to city center is a great plus.
Downside_Review: No major downsides except occasional slow service at the restaurant.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The hotel's location in the city center was convenient.
Downside_Review: Had an unfortunate experience with room service. Ordered a meal, which arrived late and cold. Also, the room seemed generally unkempt; I found uncleaned parts, especially the bathroom. Noise levels were quite high. Customer service was not up to expectations. I felt they could have been more hospitable and understanding to complaints.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The front desk staff were friendly enough upon check-in
Downside_Review: The rooms were extremely small, not room to even walk around the bed. Additionally, there was no place at all to store clothes, no closet, no dresser, nothing. The bathroom layout was also odd, with the toilet almost in the shower. Elevators were slow. The hotel was noisy with lots of guests partying till late at night.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The location of the Hilton is great, being close to the city center.
Downside_Review: I was extremely disappointed with the quality of service at this Hilton location. My room was not clean upon arrival and had to be switched. Once in the new room, the noise from the street below was overwhelming. Not to mention, the wifi was incredibly slow and made it very hard to get any work done. The staff was not very helpful when these issues were brought up.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The proximity to nearby attractions and the public transportation was convenient.
Downside_Review: I found the hotel's room quality to be underwhelming. The rooms were not cleaned properly and I experienced issues with the plumbing. Room service was rather slow and the food was mediocre at best. The hotel staff seemed uninterested and not happy to assist.

Hotel Name: Motto by Hilton Washington DC City Center
Upside_Review: The location was great, close to many attractions.
Downside_Review: The rooms were disappointingly small, almost cramped. The restaurant had limited options and service was slow. The soundproofing was also not adequate, we could hear noise from the hallway easily.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown was a truly delightful place to stay. It is strategically positioned close to major attractions like the White House, making it a convenient location for tourists. The rooms were well-maintained, spacious and offered comfortable beds for a good night's sleep. The staff members were courteous and readily available to cater to all our requirements. The breakfast variety was excellent and the fitness center was a nice surprise.
Downside_Review: I honestly did not find any glaring faults during my stay here.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: Great position for sightseeing, near the White House and National Monuments. Staff are incredibly friendly and helpful.
Downside_Review: Only downside is that breakfast isn't included, but plenty of places nearby to eat.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown was a delight to stay at. The location was top-notch - close to all the important landmarks and the metro station. The rooms were clean and spacious, and the staff was courteous and helpful. The breakfast was fantastic, offering a large variety of options. The hotel also has a well-equipped fitness center. This is really a great place to stay, and I highly recommend it.
Downside_Review: I can't think of any downside. Everything was wonderful during my stay.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown has been a wonderful experience. The staff was always courteous and quick to assist. The room was very accommodating, equipped with all necessary amenities, and provided a comfortable stay. The locality is great too, nearby major attractions, and easy access to transportation.
Downside_Review: There was minor noise from the street during peak hours, however, it didn't affect our stay, and the hotel can't control it. Other than that, our experience was delightful.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The hotel maintains a prime location, close to the major attractions. The staff is courteous and very helpful. Rooms are spacious and clean, providing a comfortable stay.
Downside_Review: Breakfast options could be more varied to cater to a broader palette.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The location was convenient as it was situated close to most touristic spots.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, our stay at the Hilton Garden Inn was not pleasant. The room was in mediocre condition upon arrival with worn out furniture and carpet. Furthermore, the housekeeping was sporadic, often forgetting to stock rooms with clean towels and toiletries. Noise seemed to be a big issue due to thin walls and floors. We could hear our neighbors' conversations and other noises clearly which was very inconvenient. On top of that, the staff appeared to be untrained and unprofessional. They were not helpful when we asked for assistance and displayed a poor customer service attitude. Overall, our experience did not live up to the expectations we had for a Hilton establishment.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The location of Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown is fairly decent, being located close to several major attractions.
Downside_Review: My experience at Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown was unfortunately disappointing. The staff were generally unhelpful and often seemed disinterested in their guests. The quality of the room was subpar with uncomfortable beds and outdated bathrooms. To add to this, the hotel seems to be struggling with cleanliness issues with the common areas often being left untidy. The noise level was also a frequent problem, causing significant disturbances during evenings and early mornings.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The hotel's location is convenient, right in the heart of downtown, and the lobby area is welcoming.
Downside_Review: I'm utterly disappointed by the level of customer service. The front desk staff seemed uninterested, bordering on rude. Also, our room was not cleaned well; we even found some leftover snacks from the previous guests in the drawers. The breakfast was below average for the price we paid. I expect better from a Hilton.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: The location of the hotel is fantastic - close to the city center and most of the popular touristic spots.
Downside_Review: The room was average nothing special for the price they charge. The room's cleanliness was in question. Found hair in the bathroom. Plus no complimentary breakfast, even at the price point. The front desk staff seemed disinterested and not very helpful either.

Hotel Name: Hilton Garden Inn Washington DC Downtown
Upside_Review: Friendly staff and good location.
Downside_Review: Room service was disappointing with limited options and food choices. The room was smaller than we expected and the bathroom needed a deeper clean.

Upside_Review: State Plaza Hotel provides spacious suites, a super convenient location close to many landmarks, and very efficient and friendly staff. The in-house dining was also quite delightful.
Downside_Review: Nothing noteworthy.

Upside_Review: The staff were very friendly and accommodating. The location of the hotel was ideal as it was close to many city attractions. The rooms were clean and well-furnished.

The State Plaza Hotel in Washington offers a marvelous location close to all important tourist destinations and a sense of peace and tranquility despite being in the heart of the city. The staff are friendly and attentive, and the hotel's restaurant offers a delicious breakfast spread every morning. The spacious rooms are impeccably kept and equipped with everything you could need for a comfortable stay.
Downside_Review: One minor complaint would be that the coffee provided in the room could be of better quality. Also, I noticed that the Wi-Fi connection was a bit unstable at times.

Upside_Review: Fantastic location! Close to major tourist attractions and staff were very friendly. The room was also spacious, clean, and well-equipped.
Downside_Review: Some minor maintenance issues in the bathroom that were resolved promptly by the hotel staff.

Upside_Review: I was extremely impressed with the State Plaza Hotel in Washington. From the friendly and accommodating staff to the clean and comfortable rooms, my experience was nothing short of excellent. In particular, I enjoyed the hotel's central location which allowed for easy access to major sights and landmarks. I would wholeheartedly recommend the State Plaza Hotel to anyone planning a trip to Washington.
Downside_Review: There was nothing noteworthy on the negative side.

Upside_Review: It's in a good location and within walking distance to several local attractions.
Downside_Review: There were several downsides during our stay. The bathroom was not clean upon arrival and the room was damp with an unpleasant odor. The walls seem paper thin as we could hear everything from the other rooms, making it hard to sleep. The customer service is wanting, with staff lacking in professionalism and responsiveness.

Upside_Review: The location was convenient, close to many tourist attractions.
Downside_Review: The rooms were dated and could use some renovations. Additionally, the customer service was lacking and staff were not as responsive or courteous as expected.

Upside_Review: The location of the hotel was its only saving grace as it was conveniently placed near many of Washington's popular attractions.
Downside_Review: However, the rooms were quite dated with old furnishings and basic amenities. I had to call multiple times for basic necessities such as toiletries, only to get a delayed response. The noise from the hallway was herculean and even the slightest sounds from neighbouring rooms were distracting, making it difficult for a peaceful night's sleep. Wi-Fi connection was often erratic and the customer service was underwhelming - the staff were standoffish and not very accommodating with requests or complaints.

Upside_Review: Location was great, within walking distance to several landmarks and sights.
Downside_Review: The hotel looks quite tired and needs a lot of refurbishment. The heating system was noisy and we could hear everything from the street, the windows need to be replaced. We also had issues with the plumbing in our bathroom that took two days to fix. The staff were not particularly friendly or helpful and seemed overwhelmed.

Upside_Review: The hotel location was fantastic, close to many attractions in Washington.
Downside_Review: However, the service was subpar to say the least. The staff often seemed disorganized and unprepared. There were multiple issues with the booking and the cleanliness of the room left a lot to be desired.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center hotel was exceptional. Conveniently situated in proximity to the convention center, it made my business engagement stress free. The rooms were comfortable, spacious, and spotlessly clean with a great view of the downtown area. The staff were also very accommodating and helpful, always ready to assist with a smile. The hotel also has some excellent amenities including a fitness center and a fantastic restaurant. It definitely felt like a home away from home.
Downside_Review: There were a few minor issues like the bathroom door not closing properly and the Wi-Fi was intermittently slow, but they were quickly addressed by the hotel's efficient maintenance team.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The hotel is centrally located, making most major attractions just a short walk or metro ride away. Rooms were clean and tidy with comfortable beds. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. The on-site restaurant served hearty and tasty meals.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center honestly exceeded all my expectations. From its prime location in downtown Washington, which makes exploring the city extremely convenient, to the polite and attentive staff, it offered a top-notch experience. The rooms were quite spacious and clean, with comfortable beds that made every night's sleep utterly rejuvenating. The dining options available at the hotel were also noteworthy, as their in-house restaurant served a great variety of delectable meals.
Downside_Review: I would have loved it if the hotel had a swimming pool, though its absence didn’t dampen my overall experience.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The location is excellent with easy access to public transport and nearby attractions. The service staff was also very helpful and polite.
Downside_Review: The breakfast was quite basic and could do with more variety.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: Rooms are modern and well appointed, staff are friendly and efficient, location is great for the convention center
Downside_Review: Menu in the bistro is somewhat limited

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The building is majestic and the location was great, very close to the convention center.
Downside_Review: The room was much smaller than I expected and the cleanliness was subpar. The air conditioner was extremely loud and disrupted my sleep. The pricing felt too high for the services offered.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The location was convenient
Downside_Review: The bathroom was not clean and had an awful smell. Also, the bedroom was too small and the facilities were out of date. The room service was extremely slow and the food was below average. Definitely, I don't recommend this hotel to anyone.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The central location of the hotel was a plus, and the façade of the building was impressive.
Downside_Review: Our stay in Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown was disappointingly inadequate. The room seemed cleaned on the surface, but once we settled in, we noticed the linens were not well laundered and there were stains on the carpet. The room was also quite noisy, with soundproofing seeming almost non-existent. Additionally, room service seemed scarce and there were issues with our billing that took a significant time to rectify. Furthermore, the Wi-Fi connection was frustratingly unstable.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: The location of the hotel was excellent. It was right in downtown Washington with several points of interest within walking distance. The lobby was chic and the common areas were tidy.
Downside_Review: The room had a strange musty smell, and unfortunately, despite bringing it up with the staff, it was never addressed. The rooms were not as clean as expected and some parts of the room had visible dust and dirt. The service staff were inconsistent in their approach to customer service. Some were very friendly whereas others were quite rude and unhelpful. The Wi-Fi also kept disconnecting, which made working from the room a nightmare. Additionally, the hotel restaurant was overpriced for the quality of food served.

Hotel Name: Courtyard by Marriott Washington Downtown/Convention Center
Upside_Review: Central location
Downside_Review: Room service was poor, they left our room without being cleaned a few times

Upside_Review: An incredible location, only a short walk to Georgetown. Spacious rooms and very friendly staff. Views from the hotel are amazing, overlooking the city.

The Glover Park Hotel Georgetown not only had top-notch service, its proximity to key places of interest in Washington was also a major highlight. The rooms were well-kept and the general atmosphere of the hotel was wonderful.
Downside_Review: However, the parking situation was a bit tricky, would advise exploring other parking options.

Upside_Review: Great staff, very friendly and accommodating. Room was clean and quiet. The location is perfect, safe neighborhood and very close to Metro.
Downside_Review: There is room for improvement with the breakfast options. A wider selection would have been appreciated.

Upside_Review: Very convenient location near Georgetown University with easy access to the city centre. Massive, comfortable and well-cleaned rooms.
Downside_Review: The breakfast recall might be better and the lighting in the hallways and the hotels should be brighter.

Upside_Review: The hotel is uber luxurious and is surrounded by vibrant city life. It's very close to various tourist locations. Comfortable rooms and commendable service by the staff made our stay a memorable one.
Downside_Review: There is nothing to note for the downside.

Upside_Review: Close proximity to universities and attractions in Georgetown
Downside_Review: Dirty rooms, broken air conditioning system and unhelpful staff made the stay unpleasant

Upside_Review: The lobby and dining area were clean and inviting.
Downside_Review: The room was dated and the bathroom was not as clean as expected. The service was also not great, with staff seeming to be unconcerned about guests' needs. The location, while scenic, was a distance from the central city which made transportation inconvenient.

Upside_Review: The location of the Glover Park Hotel Georgetown was quite good.
Downside_Review: Unfortunately, the service was not at the expected standard for such a hotel. Rooms were not tidied up regularly and staff were not very responsive or helpful. Also, the meals served at the in-house restaurant left a lot to be desired in terms of taste and value for money.

Upside_Review: The location of the Glover Park Hotel Georgetown was convenient, and the lobby was aesthetically pleasing.
Downside_Review: The hotel had numerous issues such as: stale and musty air, worn-out furniture, and an unfriendly hotel staff who were not very helpful. The noise from the highway was audible inside the room, leading to a disturbed sleep. The amenities provided were also below average, and the cleanliness of the room left a lot to be desired.

Upside_Review: Historic neighborhood
Downside_Review: Rooms were dated and had poor soundproofing.

Upside_Review: This hotel is in a perfect location, just three blocks or so from the White House. The staff was friendly and the rooms were clean and comfortable. I also appreciated the fact that there were many restaurants and shops within walking distance.
Downside_Review: The only downside was that the Wi-Fi was spotty at times and the breakfast was average, but these were minor details in an otherwise excellent stay.

Upside_Review: The Hamilton Hotel - Washington DC provided an exceptional stay. From the warm welcomes from the friendly staff to the sheer elegance of the architecture, our experience was nothing short of perfection. The rooms were spacious and impeccably clean, offering a stunning view of the cityscape. The convenient location in the heart of Washington DC made sightseeing a breeze, providing easy access to public transportation. The in-hotel restaurant also deserves mention - the diverse menu and fine-dining experience were impressive.
Downside_Review: While our overall experience was memorable, I found the Wi-Fi connection to be somewhat spotty at times within the room, which could be inconvenient for business travelers.

Upside_Review: The Hamilton Hotel in Washington DC was a splendid experience for me. From its spacious rooms, pristine conditions, and modern amenities, everything was top-notch. The on-site dining was gourmet quality and the staff were friendly and hospitable. Its close proximity to landmarks and sites of interest was another major advantage.
Downside_Review: None. I had a delightful stay.

Upside_Review: The Hamilton Hotel is conveniently located close to lots of attractions. The staff were quite helpful when asked for assistance and the whole structure has an old-time charm which is quite pleasing.
Downside_Review: While the hotel overall was quite nice, I did find the cost of room service to be a bit high compared to other hotels I've stayed at.

Upside_Review: Excellent hotel with good location, just about a mile from the White House! There are several restaurants in walking distance. The staff was friendly and the rooms were large and clean.
Downside_Review: Nothing to complain about.

Upside_Review: The hotel is centrally located and the staff were polite.
Downside_Review: Despite its good location, the rooms were small and had an old smell. The air conditioning was a little noisy. The price was too high compared to the service provided.

Upside_Review: centrally located
Downside_Review: dated interior and lousy service, plus way overpriced for what you get

Upside_Review: Fabulous location for exploring Washington DC
Downside_Review: The room was very small and the hotel was overpriced for what it offered.

Upside_Review: The primary plus for this hotel is its location

Downside_Review: 하지만, 아침 식사의 선택이 조금 제한적이었습니다.

Upside_Review: 버그데이 호텔은 위치가 아주 좋았어요. 안카라의 주요 관광지로 이동하기 편했습니다. 또한 호텔의 직원들은 매우 친절했고, 언제나 준비된 태도로 요구사항을 들어주었습니다. 객실도 넓고 깨끗하며, 침대는 편안했습니다. 아침식사도 맛있었어요. 이러한 모든 이유로 인해 다른 여행자들에게 이 호텔을 추천드립니다.
Downside_Review: 그러나 이 호텔의 인터넷 연결은 약간 불안정했습니다. 시간에 따라 속도가 느려질 수 있으니 이 점을 감안하시길 바랍니다.

Upside_Review: Centrum Residence의 위치는 정말 훌륭했습니다. 모든 관광명소가 호텔 주변에 있어서 아주 편리했습니다. 또한, 방은 깨끗하고 넓었으며 편안했습니다.
Downside_Review: 하지만 아침식사의 가격이 조금 비싼 편이었습니다. 그래도 다양한 음식을 먹을 수 있어서 만족스러웠습니다.

Upside_Review: 서비스가 훌륭하고, 방이 아늑하고 깨끗했습니다. 위치도 좋아서 주변을 돌아다니기에는 큰 불편함이 없었습니다.
Downside_Review: 조식 메뉴가 다양하지 않아 아쉬웠습니다. 조금 더 다양한 음식을 제공하면 좋을 것 같습니다.

Upside_Review: Sky Ankara Big Suit Home은 편리한 위치, 친절한 직원, 그리고 깨끗한 방을 제공합니다. 무엇보다도 넓은 스위트룸이 매력적입니다. 이 호텔을 선택한 것은 정말 좋은 결정이었습니다.
Downside_Review: 별다른 불편함은 없었습니다.

Upside_Review: 바흐첼리에프러 호텔은 아나카라에서의 제 숙박을 매우 즐겁게 만들어 주었습니다. 직원들은 친절하고 전문적이었으며, 방은 깨끗하고 편안했습니다. 호텔의 위치는 중심가에 가깝고 주요 관광지를 쉽게 방문할 수 있었습니다.
Downside_Review: 다만, 음식이 조금 실망스러웠습니다. 더 다양하고 현지 특산물을 활용한 메뉴가 있었다면 좋았을 텐데, 메뉴가 다소 일반적이었습니다. 또한, 소음이 좀 있어 깊은 잠을 잘 수 없었습니다.

Hotel Name: 홀리데이 인 익스프레스 베이징 후아카이(Holiday Inn Express Beijing Huacai, an IHG Hotel)
Upside_Review: 홀리데이 인 익스프레스 베이징 후아카이 호텔의 위치는 멋있었습니다. 직원들은 상당히 친절했고, 객실은 아주 깨끗하고 편안했습니다. 아침식사 메뉴도 다양하고 맛있었습니다.
Downside_Review: 다만, 무선 인터넷 연결이 약간 느렸던 것이 흠이지만, 그것을 제외하고는 대체적으로 만족스러웠습니다.

Hotel Name: 홀리데이 인 익스프레스 베이징 후아카이(Holiday Inn Express Beijing Huacai, an IHG Hotel)
Upside_Review: 호텔 내부는 깔끔하게 유지되고 있었습니다.
Downside_Review: 직원들의 서비스가 매우 불만족스러웠습니다. 문의사항에 대해 불친절하게 대응하였고, 요청사항도 제대로 들어주지 않았습니다. 또한 방음이 잘 되지 않아, 밤에는 옆방의 소음 때문에 잠을 제대로 이루지 못했습니다.

Upside_Review: 객실은 매우 넓고 모던한 편이며, 특히 침대가 아주 편안했습니다. 위치도 중심지에 있어 편리했습니다. 호텔 직원들이 매우 친절했고, 레스토랑의 음식도 훌륭했습니다.
Downside_Review: 호텔 내부가 조금 오래된 느낌이었지만, 그래도 청결하게 관리되고 있었습니다.

Upside_Review: 고급스럽고 넓은 객실, 친절한 직원,의 위치 등 다양한 편의 시설.
Downside_Review: 살짝 지나치게 비싸다고 느껴질 수도 있을 것 같습니다

Upside_Review: 공공 구석 과 여러 시설 권의 꼭옹
Downside_Review: 감사 스크릿스테 제고과 스키스셋보더의 택배에 노이즘이 갔습니다. 저용가능 조금 다른 것이 필요한 수 있습니다

Upside_Review: 방은 깨끗하고 아늑했습니다. 직원들은 매우 친절하고 잘 통역할 수 있었습니다. 위치는 왕푸징 근처로 이동하기 매우 편리했습니다.
Downside_Review: 아침식사가 다양하고 맛있었지만 가격이 조금 비쌌습니다.
룸 서비스가 느리고, 먹거리의 품질도 좋지 않았습니다. 또한, 전반적인 청결 상태를 향상시킬 필요가 있습니다.

Upside_Review: 원체크인에서 프로필 링크를 편리하게 설정하여 가격을 무료로 업그레이드했습니다. 방차를 바꾼 것이 특히 반갑습니다. 설레러리요거다 수강중에 개인주차장을 쓰다구 않고 체공스폰 들었을 때, 베이징방의 중앙에 있는 주차장은 국제 출입국온점의 트래피에 있는 바우점이었어요.
Downside_Review: 긴귀화없이 베이징 홈디폰에서 선수사 완료 비율이 오직에 소피함을 끼린것 같아요. 선수사 속본을 한편도 보낸 적이 없었는데, 방뒤에 매국에 부대던 주의를 받지 못한 웃음 사항이 있었습니다.

Downside_Review: 확실히 불만을 제기할만한 문제는 있었지만, 작은 것들이었고 전반적인 경험에는 크게 영향을 주지 않았습니다. 예를 들어, 객실에 차와 커피를 만들 수 있는 시설이 없었는데, 이는 편의를 위해 추가되면 좋겠습니다.

Upside_Review: 베이씩 히어로균에서 계속 탈탄했던 한국인 입니다. 에셨는 나름 타당한 위치에 있었고, 내부 시설이 큰 모델 호텔보다가 비어 크지 않아서 골술한 뒤 송과하게 믿게 되었습니다. 서비스 직원들이 확실히 착오해서 가장 진열했고, 클로즈 없을 때도 천휴을 정리해 주었습니다. 쾌적인 치안을 살림에게 비치셨어서, 호텔이 많이 만족했습니다.

Hotel Name: 샹그릴라 차이나 월드 서밋 윙, 베이징(China World Summit Wing, Beijing)

Downside_Review: 조식 옵션이 약간 제한적이었지만 그래도 전반적으로 맛있었습니다.

Upside_Review: 페어몬트 베이징은 위치, 시설, 서비스 모두가 탁월했습니다. 특히 숙소의 청결함은 훌륭했고, 직원들의 친절함은 더할 나위 없었습니다.
Downside_Review: 비록, 레스토랑 서비스의 퀄리티가 조금 아쉬웠지만 전반적인 호텔에 대한 만족도를 크게 떨어뜨릴 수준은 아니었습니다.

Downside_Review: 고층 옵션을 선택하면 조금 시설이 물어납니다. 하지만, 정말로 중요한 문제는 아닙니다. 핫라옹 윙니개 조금 더 깔끔하고 더 깔끔하게 만들 수 있을 것이라고 생각합니다.

Downside_Review: 호텔방이 조금 좁게 느껴졌지만, 그래도 깔끔해서 만족스러웠습니다

Hotel Name: 마이닝거 호텔 베를린 하우프트반호프(MEININGER Hotel Berlin Hauptbahnhof)

Downside_Review: 방 소음이 조금 있었던 것이 아쉬웠습니다.

Hotel Name: 마이닝거 호텔 베를린 하우프트반호프(MEININGER Hotel Berlin Hauptbahnhof)

Upside_Review: 호텔의 위치는 좋았음
Downside_Review: 하지만 내용이 지나체 부족하하였습니다. 방이 너무 작았으며, 집을 놓으려면 공간이 너무 부족하다구요! 물질이 경약하며, 서비스 차 표준 라운지가 바라졌으며, 침대가 나못됐으면 플로어도 나왔어요. 플로어가 나고 찾아보면 최소 겨울에 있는 방에 쉽게 찾을 수 있는 게 예쁘더라구요. 새로운 창고바닥, 복편이 참 겨울엔 열리는 감손을 쳐주지 못했어요.

Upside_Review: 호텔의 위치는 동대문과 근접해있어, 장보기와 쇼핑하기에 편리했습니다.
Downside_Review: 그러나, 방 상태가 참으로 좋지 않았습니다. 청결 상태가 엉망이었으며, 서비스도 만족스럽지 못했습니다. 여기에 방음이 매우 잘 안되어, 편안한 휴식을 취하기 어려웠습니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스

Downside_Review: 가격이 다른 호텔에 비해 조금 비싼 편이지만, 제공하는 서비스와 시설을 고려하면 충분히 가치가 있다고 생각합니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스
Upside_Review: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔은 아주 훌륭한 호텔입니다. 위치가 좋아서 이동하기 편리했고, 서비스도 매우 만족스러웠습니다. 또한, 객실이 깨끗하고 편안해서 편히 쉴 수 있었습니다.
Downside_Review: 가격이 조금 비싼 편이지만, 서비스와 편의 시설을 고려했을 때 그럴 만한 가치가 있다고 생각합니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스

Downside_Review: 특별히 불편한 점은 없었지만, 주차장이 좀 더 넓었으면 좋겠다는 아쉬움이 남았습니다. 그 외에는 모든 부분에서 만족스러웠습니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스
Upside_Review: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔앤 레지던스는 명동과 동대문 수입상가가 가까워서 쇼핑을 즐기기 아주 좋은 위치에 있었습니다. 호텔에서 부대시설 총알도 매우 만족스러웠습니다. 특히 피트니스 센터와 수영장이 깨끗하게 관리되어 있어 매일 이용하였습니다. 또한, 직원들의 서비스 정신이 뛰어나 질문에도 정확하고 친절하게 답변해 주셨습니다. 룸 서비스 음식도 맛있었습니다.
Downside_Review: 아쉬운 점이 있다면, 주변에 대중교통 이용이 어려운 점이 있습니다. 마지막으로 체크아웃 시간이 조금 늦었으면 더 좋았을 것 같습니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스

Downside_Review: 그러나, 레스토랑에서 음식의 품질이 조금 더 나아질 수 있습니다. 음식이 나쁘지는 않았지만, 나는 호텔에서 먹을 만한 것으로 기대했었습니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스
Upside_Review: 객실이 깨끗하고 현대적이었고, 서비스 직원들이 친절했습니다. 위치도 서울 동대문 지역의 주요 관광지와 가까워 편리했습니다.

Hotel Name: 노보텔 앰배서더 서울 동대문 호텔 앤 레지던스

Hotel Name: Club Quarters Hotel White House, Washington DC

Downside_Review: Сервис в отеле был разочаровывающим, персонал не был дружелюбный. Номер был старым и не очень чистым. Ванная показалась слегка заброшенной. Бюфет завтрака был скромным, а вкус блюд оставлял много желать лучшего. Общий опыт был далек от моей ожидаемой качества.

Очень комфортабельно и приятно. Удобное местоположение, в центре города. Персонал очень внимательный и отзывчивый.
Downside_Review: Таких не нашлось.

Upside_Review: Отель находится в центре города, недалеко от некоторых достопримечательностей.

Upside_Review: Отель расположен близ аэропорта, что очень удобно. Персонал был очень дружелюбный и ответил на все вопросы.
Downside_Review: Были проблемы с чистотой. Особенно в ванной комнате. Нехватало возможности заказать пищу и напитки в номер. Ресторан отеля не слишком интересный.

Upside_Review: Близкое расположение к аэропорту было единственным преимуществом.
Downside_Review: Обащий уровень гостиницы оставляет желать лучшего. Номера скудно обставлены, не было элементарных удобств, таких как шампунь или гель для душа. Постельное белье и полотенца были пожелтевшими и показались мне не очень чистыми. Бронирование включало завтрак, но качество еды было очень низким. Овощи не были свежими, а выпечка была заветренной. В комнатах не было звукоизоляции, так что мне было сложно уснуть из-за шума в коридорах и соседних комнатах. Кроме того, персонал был недружелюбным и не отзывчивым на мои запросы. Учитывая стоимость проживания, я ожидал большего от ibis Ankara Airport Hotel.

Upside_Review: Отель находится близко к аэропорту, что является удобным для тех, кто прилетает на отдых в Анкару.
Downside_Review: Комнаты были нечистыми, при приветствии использован прошедший текстиль. Еда в ресторане была не такая вкусная, как ожидалось от такой известной сети, как Ibis. Персонал был недостаточно профессионален и не всегда помогал решить возникшиев проблемы.

Upside_Review: Удобное месторасположение от аэропорта.
Downside_Review: Услуги плохие, пища была невкусная, и персонал был недоброжелен.

Upside_Review: Близость к аэропорту
Downside_Review: Плохая звукоизоляция, некомфортные кровати

Upside_Review: Близость к аэропорту
Downside_Review: Номера неухживые, шумно от самолетов. персонал недоброжеливый, не всегда был горячий душ

Upside_Review: Близость к аэропорту и удобный трансфер.
Downside_Review: Пребывание в отеле было ужасным. Комната была жутко грязной, пол грязный и пыльный. В ванной были волосы и со следами от грязи. Персонал очень неприветлив и груб. Бесплатный Wi-Fi постоянно отключался, что создавало большие неудобства. Завтрак был просто ужасным, выбор продуктов был минимальным, а сама еда была невкусной.

Upside_Review: Отель был достаточно удобный для доступа к аэропорту.
